title: Scaffolding the Strategist: Architecture-Dependent Reasoning Interventions in Hotelling Spatial Markets
author: [[Pratyush Singh]]
description: arXiv:2607.09743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate whether structured reasoning interventions improve the strategic economic reasoning of large language models, and whether their effects depend on model architecture. Using Hotelling's linear city model as a diagnostic vehicle, we evaluate GPT-4.1-mini (a standard instruction-following model) and GPT-5-mini (a reasoning-optimized model) under five conditions - an unscaffolded baseline and four reasoning interventions - across eight questions spanning deductive and abductive reasoning, three prompt framings, and three repetitions per condition, yielding 720 individually judged responses. We find a statistically significant crossover interaction between scaffolding type and model architecture ($t(7) = 4.79$, $p = 0.002$, $d = 1.69$): commitment scaffolding improves the standard model ($+0.21$) while degrading the reasoning model ($-0.63$), and principled separation shows the opposite pattern ($-0.40$ vs. $+0.31$). Both crossovers are individually significant (commitment: $p = 0.040$; separation: $p = 0.002$) and hold across all eight questions with 7/8 directional consistency. Adversarial stress-testing harms both models, with $2.6\times$ greater degradation for the reasoning model ($-1.47$ vs. $-0.57$; $p = 0.038$), and the damage correlates negatively with baseline difficulty ($R^2 = 0.36$, $p = 0.014$). We further document a persistent declarative-procedural gap in which both models identify correct strategies at rates far exceeding their ability to execute them; separation fully closes this gap for the reasoning model while no intervention helps the standard model.
tldr: 该研究以 Hotelling 线性城市模型为诊断工具，评估了 GPT-4.1-mini 和 GPT-5-mini 在五种推理干预条件下的战略经济推理能力，发现推理干预效果高度依赖模型架构，存在统计显著的交叉交互作用。
objective_summary: 研究者使用 Hotelling 线性城市模型，对 GPT-4.1-mini（标准指令遵循模型）和 GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）在五种条件（无脚手架基线加四种推理干预）下进行评估，涵盖八个涉及演绎和溯因推理的问题、三种提示框架及每种条件三次重复，共产生 720 个独立判断响应。结果发现脚手架类型与模型架构之间存在统计显著的交叉交互作用（t(7)=4.79, p=0.002, d=1.69）：承诺脚手架提升标准模型 0.21 分但降低推理模型 0.63 分，原则分离则呈现相反模式。对抗性压力测试对两个模型均有损害，对推理模型的损害程度是标准模型的 2.6 倍。研究者还发现两个模型均存在陈述性-程序性差距，即识别正确策略的能力远超执行能力。
key_logic_flow: 研究者以 Hotelling 线性城市模型作为诊断工具，设计了评估大语言模型战略经济推理能力的系统性实验框架。
实验涉及 GPT-4.1-mini（标准指令遵循模型）和 GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）两种架构，在无脚手架基线和四种推理干预条件下进行对比。
实验包含八个问题、三种提示框架和每种条件三次重复，共产生 720 个独立判断响应用于统计分析。
研究发现脚手架类型与模型架构之间存在统计显著的交叉交互作用（t(7)=4.79, p=0.002, d=1.69）。
承诺脚手架提升标准模型 0.21 分但降低推理模型 0.63 分，原则分离则呈现相反模式（-0.40 vs +0.31），两种交叉效应均统计显著。
对抗性压力测试对两个模型均有损害，对推理模型的损害（-1.47）是标准模型（-0.57）的 2.6 倍，且损害程度与基线难度负相关。

paper_metadata.title: Scaffolding the Strategist: Architecture-Dependent Reasoning Interventions in Hotelling Spatial Markets

research_problem.core_question: 结构化的推理干预（scaffolding）是否能提升大语言模型在战略经济推理中的表现，以及效果是否因模型架构（标准指令跟随模型 vs. 推理优化模型）而异？
research_problem.motivation: 大语言模型在经济推理、战略决策等复杂认知任务中表现出潜力但性能参差不齐。不同的模型架构——尤其是标准指令跟随模型与推理优化模型——可能对提示策略和推理支架产生截然不同的响应。理解这种架构依赖的差异化效应，对于设计高效的推理辅助工具、指导提示工程实践以及评估LLM的推理边界具有重要价值。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 现有研究大多关注单一提示策略对所有模型的通用效果，缺乏对推理干预策略在不同架构LLM上差异化影响的系统实证比较，尤其是在战略经济推理这一特定认知领域中的交互效应分析。

methodology.approach_summary: 该研究以Hotelling线性城市模型作为战略经济推理的诊断场景，设计了五种实验条件——一个无支架基线（unscaffolded baseline）和四种结构化推理干预（commitment scaffolding、principled separation、notetaking、adversarial stress-testing），在GPT-4.1-mini（标准指令跟随模型）和GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）上进行对比评估。实验覆盖8个问题（涵盖演绎推理与溯因推理）、3种提示框架、每种条件重复3次，共产生720个独立判断。通过配对t检验、Cohen's d效应量、线性回归等统计方法分析脚手架类型与模型架构之间的交互效应。
key_innovations: 首次系统揭示推理干预策略与模型架构之间存在显著的交叉交互效应（crossover interaction），即同一干预策略对不同架构模型产生方向相反的效果（commitment scaffolding提升标准模型+0.21但降低推理模型-0.63）
发现并量化了"陈述-程序性差距"（declarative-procedural gap）——两类模型识别正确策略的能力远超其实际执行能力，且separation干预能完全消除推理模型的这一差距
inspiration_sources: Hotelling线性城市模型（经典经济空间竞争模型）
认知科学中的scaffolding理论
LLM推理能力评估相关研究（思维链、自我一致性等）
模型架构比较研究方法论

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 使用Hotelling线性城市模型作为单一诊断性评测场景，涵盖8个问题（包括演绎推理和溯因推理类型）、3种提示框架（中性/鼓励/抑制），每种实验条件重复3次，共产生720个独立判断样本。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 发现scaffolding类型与模型架构之间存在显著的交叉交互效应（t(7)=4.79, p=0.002, d=1.69）：commitment scaffolding提升标准模型+0.21但降低推理模型-0.63；principled separation呈现相反模式（标准模型-0.40 vs 推理模型+0.31）；adversarial stress-testing对推理模型的损害是标准模型的2.6倍（-1.47 vs -0.57, p=0.038）

reviewer_concerns: 仅使用Hotelling线性城市模型单一经济场景作为测试基准，结论的战略经济推理泛化性存疑
仅测试了OpenAI的两代模型（GPT-4.1-mini和GPT-5-mini），无法断言结论适用于其他模型家族（如Claude、Llama、Gemini等）
8个问题的样本量相对有限，尽管统计显著但效应量的稳健性需更大规模实验验证
推理干预的具体设计（prompt措辞）可能对结果产生非预期影响，缺乏对干预本身的设计空间探索
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 实验仅基于Hotelling线性城市模型这一特定的空间竞争经济模型，且仅涉及两个OpenAI模型。结论能否泛化到其他类型的经济推理任务（如博弈论、拍卖理论、一般均衡模型）以及其他模型架构（如非Transformer架构、开源模型）尚未得到验证。

applicable_domains: LLM评估与基准测试方法论
提示工程与推理辅助工具设计
AI辅助经济分析与战略决策系统
模型选型与能力边界评估
industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: 研究本身的执行成本较低（仅需OpenAI API调用），但其核心发现——不同架构模型需要差异化的推理干预策略——对提示工程实践具有直接的指导价值。企业可根据模型架构类型选择适配的推理支架策略，避免"一刀切"式提示优化带来的负面效果。然而，从研究发现转化为工程化工具（如自适应scaffolding选择器）仍需进一步研发投入。

closest_prior_works: LLM推理能力评估系列研究（如Chain-of-Thought、Self-Consistency、Tree-of-Thoughts等提示策略的效果评估）
模型架构比较研究（标准模型 vs. 推理优化模型在各类任务上的表现差异）
Hotelling模型在AI行为分析中的应用研究
related_work_context.advancement_over_prior: 已有研究主要关注单一提示策略对所有模型的通用提升效果，或比较不同模型在某一任务上的绝对性能。该研究首次通过严格的实验设计系统性揭示了推理干预策略的效果具有架构依赖性——同一策略对不同模型产生方向相反的影响，这一发现超越了简单的"策略X是否有效"的二元结论，将提示工程的研究推向更精细化的"策略-架构匹配"层面。
potential_follow_ups: 扩展到更多经济模型（如Cournot博弈、拍卖理论、讨价还价模型）验证交叉交互效应的稳健性
在更多模型家族（Claude、Llama、Gemini、Mistral等）上复现该研究，检验架构依赖性的普遍性
探索自适应推理干预系统——根据模型架构和任务难度动态选择最佳scaffolding策略
深入研究"陈述-程序性差距"的根源机制，探索弥合该差距的训练方法或架构改进
将推理干预的设计空间系统化，探索更多类型的scaffolding策略及其交互效应

title: ToolVerse: Unlocking Massive Environments and Long-Horizon Tasks for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
author: [[Shuaiyu Zhou, Fengpeng Yue, Zengjie Hu, Yuanzhe Shen, Chenyang Zhang, feng hong, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng]]
description: arXiv:2607.15660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While LLM agents demonstrate strong reasoning abilities in compact and well-defined scenarios, they struggle to maintain robustness and effectiveness when faced with large-scale, diverse, and dynamic real-world environments that demand seamless tool integration. To address this gap, we introduce ToolVerse, a comprehensive framework that scales up agentic RL environments and enables agents to perform complex long-horizon reasoning in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) tasks. First, ToolVerse automatically builds the massive executable agent training environments from nearly 400 real-world Model Context Protocols (MCPs) that contain about 4500 tools. Second, we propose a task design strategy based on a tool dependency graph, utilizing Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm to generate long-horizon tasks, and produce GUST (Graph Unlocking Sampling Tasks) dataset. Third, to alleviate the credit assigment problem in long-horizon agentic RL, we propose a fine-grained Turn-Aware Relative Advantage algorithm. We conduct extensive Agentic RL training using ToolVerse and evaluate our framework on serveral agentic benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly strengthens LLMs' capabilities in long-horizon tool use, achieving a marked performance boost and showcasing robust reasoning within dynamic environments.
tldr: ToolVerse 是一个基于近 400 个真实世界 MCP（约 4500 个工具）构建的大规模智能体强化学习框架，通过工具依赖图和动态解锁采样算法生成长期任务，并利用 Turn-Aware Relative Advantage 算法解决信用分配问题，实验表明能显著提升 LLM 在长期工具使用任务中的表现。

title: From ML Predictions to Informed Diagnostic Assistance Using the Toulmin Model of Argumentation
author: [[Anca Marginean, Adrian Groza]]
description: arXiv:2607.09664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To provide a structured and interpretable assessment, we decompose the image-based diagnosis into components following the Toulmin model of argumentation. This model consists of a claim, grounds, warrant, qualifier, rebuttal, and backing. Consider a claim generated by a machine learning (ML) model for retinal diagnosis. Rather than accepting this claim at face value, one could either apply explainable AI (XAI) methods or adopt an argumentation-based approach. In our framework, a model specialized in biomarker extraction from images provides the grounds. The warrant-linking the grounds to the claim - is analyzed by an agent equipped with medical knowledge; in our architecture, this role is fulfilled by a MedGemma agent. The qualifier is determined based on the overall quantitative evaluation of both the warrant and grounds models. Finally, a rebuttal is constructed using image similarity measures computed with MedSigLip. All these components are presented to the human expert, enabling a more informed and critical assessment of the ML-generated diagnosis.
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于 Toulmin 论证模型的医疗诊断辅助框架，将 ML 模型生成的眼底诊断结果分解为主张、依据、保证、限定词、反驳和支持等组件，并结合 MedGemma 医学知识代理和 MedSigLip 图像相似度计算，为人类专家提供结构化的可解释评估。
objective_summary: 该研究将 Toulmin 论证模型应用于 ML 驱动的视网膜图像诊断场景。框架中，一个专门的生物标志物提取模型提供依据（grounds），由 MedGemma 代理基于医学知识分析保证（warrant），通过定量评估确定限定词（qualifier），并使用 MedSigLip 计算图像相似度构造反驳（rebuttal）。最终将所有这些论证组件呈现给人类专家，辅助其更知情地评估 ML 诊断结果。论文发表于 arXiv，编号 2607.09664。
key_logic_flow: 论文提出将 Toulmin 论证模型的六要素（主张、依据、保证、限定词、反驳、支持）应用于图像诊断任务，以提升 ML 诊断结果的可解释性。
框架中的依据（grounds）由一个专门的生物标志物提取模型从眼底图像中提取。
保证（warrant）部分由一个配备医学知识的 MedGemma 代理进行分析，负责连接依据与最终诊断主张。
限定词（qualifier）基于对保证和依据模型的整体定量评估结果来确定。
反驳（rebuttal）通过 MedSigLip 计算的图像相似度度量来构建，为诊断提供对立视角。
所有论证组件汇总呈现给人类专家，使其能够对 ML 生成的诊断做出更知情的批判性评估。

research_problem.core_question: 如何利用图尔敏论证模型将机器学习模型的医学图像诊断结果转化为结构化、可解释的辅助决策信息，使人类专家能够进行更明智和批判性的评估？
research_problem.motivation: 在医学影像诊断中，ML模型的预测结果通常是黑盒的，即使使用XAI方法（如热力图）也难以提供结构化的可解释信息，临床医生难以全面理解ML预测的可靠性、限定条件和潜在反驳。论文提出使用图尔敏（Toulmin）论证模型来系统化分解诊断推理过程，为临床医生提供从依据到主张的完整论证链，从而提升人机协作诊断的透明度和可信度。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 现有XAI方法虽然能提供特征级别的可视化解释，但缺乏结构化的论证框架来帮助临床医生理解ML预测的推理逻辑、置信度限定条件和可能的反例。图尔敏论证模型提供了完整的论证结构（主张、依据、保证、限定词、反驳、背景），填补了医学AI从"黑盒预测"到"结构化论证辅助决策"之间的空白。

methodology.approach_summary: 论文提出了一种基于图尔敏论证模型的医学影像诊断辅助框架，将ML模型的视网膜诊断结果分解为六个论证组件。具体而言：一个专门提取生物标志物的模型提供"依据"（grounds）；配备医学知识的MedGemma智能体分析连接依据与主张的"保证"（warrant）；基于对保证和依据模型的量化评估确定"限定词"（qualifier）；通过MedSigLip计算的图像相似度构建"反驳"（rebuttal）；最后由"背景"（backing）提供领域知识支撑。所有论证组件以结构化方式呈现给人类专家，使其能够对ML生成的诊断进行更明智和批判性的评估。
key_innovations: 将图尔敏论证模型引入医学影像AI解释框架，用系统化的论证结构替代传统的特征可视化解释方法
利用MedGemma医学语言模型自动分析"保证"（warrant），即连接生物标志物依据与诊断主张的医学推理逻辑
基于MedSigLip跨模态图像相似度计算构建结构化的"反驳"（rebuttal）机制，提供与当前病例相似但诊断不同的对照案例

title: Closed-Loop Control with Rule-Aligned Small Language Models and Multi-Agent Self-Correction
author: [[Yuchen Wang, Javal Vyas, Tong Liu, Mehmet Mercangoz]]
description: arXiv:2607.09713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key step toward autonomous industrial operation is the ability to create and reconfigure control policies from natural-language requirement specifications, with minimal or no manual redesign. In this setting, policy generation by AI agents can be a credible path when paired with a plant-aware validator (e.g., a digital twin) that can check generated candidate actions before execution. However, practical deployment is constrained by inference latency and compute footprint: large cloud-based models are often too slow, opaque, or data-sensitive for edge closed-loop use. This work investigates whether a compact Small Language Model (SLM) can be retrained for control reasoning and embedded in a validator-guided correction loop. We use a Qwen2.5-1.5B model aligned via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), combined with (i) an action agent, (ii) a symbolic/digital-twin-style validation layer, and (iii) a reprompting agent that iteratively steers outputs toward valid actions. In randomized thermal-control simulations (30 experiments with 500 steps each), the framework achieves 91.5% average action-alignment accuracy (86.3%--100% across cases) at 3.84\,s mean inference latency. Under symbolic re-mapping, it maintains a 95% in-range rate, indicating robust physical regulation despite reduced token-level agreement. These results support SLM+validator architectures as a practical path toward reconfigurable autonomous control at the edge.
tldr: 提出SLM+验证器架构实现边缘端闭环自主控制，热控制模拟准确率91.5%
objective_summary: 该研究将Qwen2.5-1.5B小型语言模型通过GRPO对齐后，嵌入由动作生成智能体、数字孪生验证层和重新提示智能体组成的三组件自校正循环框架，用于工业闭环控制。在随机热控制模拟中达到91.5%动作对齐准确率和3.84秒平均推理延迟，验证了SLM+验证器架构用于边缘可重构自主控制的可行性。
key_logic_flow: 该研究提出了一种将小型语言模型嵌入验证器引导的自校正循环中的三组件架构，用于边缘端工业闭环控制。
核心框架包括动作生成智能体、符号化/数字孪生验证层和重新提示智能体，后者迭代地将输出引导至有效动作。
使用Qwen2.5-1.5B模型通过分组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行规则对齐训练，使其具备控制推理能力。
在随机热控制模拟中（30次实验，每次500步），框架达到91.5%的平均动作对齐准确率和3.84秒平均推理延迟。
在符号重新映射条件下，系统保持95%的在范围内率，表明具备稳健的物理调节能力。
研究结论支持SLM+验证器架构作为大模型替代方案，用于边缘端可重构自主控制的实用路径。

paper_metadata.title: Closed-Loop Control with Rule-Aligned Small Language Models and Multi-Agent Self-Correction

research_problem.core_question: 紧凑型小语言模型（SLM）能否通过对齐训练和多智能体自纠错机制，在边缘闭环控制中实现可靠的自然语言驱动的策略生成与验证？
research_problem.motivation: 工业自主操作需要能从自然语言需求规格中快速创建和重构控制策略，减少人工重新设计成本。然而，现有基于大型云端语言模型的方法存在推理延迟高、计算开销大、数据安全和模型透明性不足等问题，难以部署在边缘端实时闭环控制场景。本文探索使用紧凑型SLM（1.5B参数级别）结合验证器引导的纠错循环，作为兼顾性能和部署可行性的替代技术路线。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了'如何将小语言模型有效应用于边缘端闭环控制'的研究空白。现有工作要么依赖大规模云端LLM（延迟高、不适合边缘部署），要么使用传统控制方法（缺乏自然语言可重配置性）。SLM在控制推理中的系统化评估以及验证器引导的纠错机制尚未被充分探索，本文首次将GRPO对齐训练、多智能体纠错、数字孪生验证三者结合，为工业边缘控制提供了一条可行的技术路径。

methodology.approach_summary: 本文提出一种基于紧凑型小语言模型（SLM）的闭环控制框架，采用Qwen2.5-1.5B作为基础模型，通过Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行控制推理对齐训练。框架包含三个核心协同组件：(i) 动作智能体（Action Agent）根据当前系统状态和自然语言控制规则生成候选动作；(ii) 符号化/数字孪生验证层（Validator）模拟物理环境动力学，对候选动作进行合规性检查和物理可行性验证；(iii) 重新提示智能体（Reprompting Agent）在动作被验证层拒绝时，基于验证反馈信息迭代修正输出。三者形成'生成→验证→纠错→重试'的闭环，使紧凑的1.5B模型在无需云端大规模LLM的情况下实现可靠的控制策略生成。
key_innovations: 提出将GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）应用于小语言模型的控制推理对齐训练，赋予1.5B参数级别SLM控制策略生成与物理规则理解能力
设计多智能体自纠错架构，包含动作生成、数字孪生验证、重新提示纠错三个协同模块，形成闭环修正机制，弥补SLM在推理精度上的固有不足
在无需依赖大规模云端LLM的前提下，通过验证器引导的迭代策略达到91.5%的动作对齐精度，同时推理延迟控制在3.84秒，证明SLM+验证器架构在边缘闭环控制中的可行性

title: S1-Omni: A Unified Multimodal Reasoning Model for Scientific Understanding, Prediction, and Generation
author: [[Jiahao Zhao, Junyi Liu, Lifeng Xu, Nan Xu, Qingli Wang, Qingxiao Li, Tianle Chen, Xiaoyu Wu, Yawen Zheng, Zikai Wang, Guanming Liu, Hequn Zhou, Jingyi Wang, Jingyuan Shu, Keqi Wang, Li He, Songyang Diao, Wenhui Xu, Xinyu Ren, Yaqin Fan, Yujin Zhou, Zhanao Yao]]
description: arXiv:2607.15686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present S1-Omni, a unified multimodal reasoning model for scientific understanding, prediction, and generation. AI for Science (AI4S) has advanced significantly through domain-specific models, tool-augmented LLMs, and scientific language models. However, model capabilities remain highly fragmented, limiting the joint modeling of heterogeneous data, scientific laws, and expert knowledge. S1-Omni addresses this gap by consolidating these capabilities into a single, coherent scientific reasoning model. The architecture of S1-Omni is built upon three core components: unified representation of scientific data, natural-world knowledge alignment, and decoding for domain-specific tasks. First, S1-Omni maps natural-language instructions and scientific objects, including CIF, SMILES, protein sequences, spectra, and scientific images, into a shared representation space. Second, it incorporates scientific laws and expert knowledge into data construction and training, enabling the model to reason from scientific evidence. Third, it performs task-specific decoding to support a broad range of applications, including property prediction, spectrum-to-molecular generation, protein site and structure prediction, and scientific image generation and editing. S1-Omni is trained on S1-Omni-Corpus, which covers 200 scientific tasks and contains millions of reasoning samples, and is evaluated on over 60 scientific benchmarks. It outperforms GPT-5.5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro on most benchmarks and matches or surpasses domain-specific models on several benchmarks. Overall, S1-Omni provides a practical path toward unified scientific modeling.
tldr: S1-Omni是一个统一的多模态科学推理模型，通过统一数据表征、自然世界知识对齐和任务特定解码，将科学理解、预测和生成能力整合到单一模型中，在60多项基准测试上超越GPT-5.5和Gemini-3.1-Pro。

title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
author: [[Jihan Yao, Gantavya Bhatt, Arnav Das, Peter Jin, Ke Bao, Qiaolin Yu, Khushi Bhardwaj, Chang Su, Jialei Wang, Yikai Zhu, Sugam Devare, Damon Mosk-Aoyama, Zhen Dong, Venkat Krishna Srinivasan, Yineng Zhang, Oleksii Kuchaiev, Jiantao Jiao, Banghua Zhu, Jeff Bilmes]]
description: arXiv:2607.09739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts over multiple benchmarks whose induced model scores and rankings approximate those obtained from the full benchmark suite. In evaluation-unsupervised benchmark coreset selection (our approach), the selection algorithm uses no model evaluation outcomes, and operates on a fine granularity by producing subsets of prompts over multiple benchmarks rather than producing a sub-collection of entire benchmarks. We use submodular subset selection, and we develop and evaluate many different submodular functions for this purpose, including determinantal point process (DPP) based approaches, submodular mutual information functions, and facility location-based functions. On a new large-scale suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning five different capability categories, 18 frontier LLMs, and over 61K prompts, we find that the facility location (FL) function operating exclusively on inexpensive semantic prompt embeddings preserves LLM scores better than twelve separate score-based and diversity-based baselines, across a range of coreset budgets. Moreover, we show our proposed objective is not limited to the evaluation-unsupervised regime: in the setting where only a handful of whole benchmarks must be selected and a large amount of model scores are available, the same objective matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the MMLU and MTEB leaderboards, while being substantially cheaper to compute. Together, our results suggest that submodularity, in general, is a strong and reliable tool for benchmark compression.
tldr: 提出基于子模函数的大语言模型基准测试提示词子集选择方法，无需模型评估分数即可压缩基准测试集。
objective_summary: 该论文研究LLM基准测试的coreset选择问题，提出无需模型评估结果即可通过子模子集选择方法从多基准中选取少量提示词子集，使模型分数和排名与完整测试近似。在35个基准、18个LLM和6.1万条提示词上的实验表明，facility location函数方法优于12种基线。
key_logic_flow: 该论文研究LLM基准测试的coreset选择问题，即在完整基准测试套件中选取少量提示词子集，使其诱导的模型分数和排名与完整套件近似。
作者提出评估无监督的基准测试coreset选择方法，选择算法不使用任何模型评估结果，在细粒度上从多个基准测试中生成提示词子集。
使用子模子集选择方法，开发并评估了多种子模函数，包括基于行列式点过程(DPP)、子模互信息(SMI)和facility location(FL)的方法。
在包含35个异构基准测试、18个前沿LLM和超过6.1万条提示词的大规模套件上进行了系统性实验验证。
基于facility location函数且仅使用廉价语义嵌入的方法，在多种coreset预算下优于12种基于分数和基于多样性的基线方法。
该目标函数在仅需选择少量完整基准测试且有大量模型分数可用的场景中，与MMLU和MTEB排行榜上的最先进基线相当或更优，且计算成本更低。

paper_metadata.title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks

research_problem.core_question: 如何在不依赖任何模型评估结果（evaluation-unsupervised）的条件下，从多个LLM评测基准中自动选择出少量高代表性的prompt子集，使其产生的模型分数和排名高度近似于完整评测集的结果？
research_problem.motivation: 随着LLM评测基准的数量和规模持续膨胀（现代评测套件包含数十个基准、数万条prompt），对模型进行全面评估的计算成本变得极其高昂。现有的基准压缩（coreset selection）方法通常依赖大量模型评估分数，且多在整基准层面进行粗粒度选择，无法在prompt级别实现精细化压缩。因此，迫切需要一种高效、低成本且不依赖模型评估结果的基准子集选择方法，以大幅降低LLM评测的计算开销，同时保持评测的有效性。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了现有LLM基准coreset选择方法的两方面空白：(1) 现有方法依赖大量模型评估分数作为选择依据（evaluation-supervised），而本文首次提出完全不需要任何评估分数的评估无监督（evaluation-unsupervised）范式；(2) 现有工作通常在整基准级别进行子集选择，而本文在更细粒度的prompt级别跨基准进行联合选择，实现了更高的压缩灵活性和精度。

methodology.approach_summary: 本文提出了一种评估无监督（evaluation-unsupervised）的LLM基准coreset选择方法。方法核心是利用子模函数（submodular functions）从跨多个评测基准的prompt池中选取一个高代表性的小规模子集，选择过程完全不依赖任何模型评估分数。作者系统性地探索了三类子模函数家族：行列式点过程（DPP）、子模互信息（Submodular Mutual Information）和设施选址（Facility Location, FL）。其中，设施选址函数仅基于廉价的预训练语义嵌入（semantic embeddings）即可高效运行，无需任何模型推理。该方法在35个异构基准、5个能力类别、18个前沿LLM和61K+提示的大规模评测套件上进行了验证，并与12个基于分数和多样性的基线方法进行了对比。实验表明，仅基于语义嵌入的FL函数在保持模型评分方面全面优于所有基线，且该框架可自然扩展到传统的有监督整基准选择场景。
key_innovations: 首次提出"评估无监督"（evaluation-unsupervised）范式用于LLM基准coreset选择，选择过程完全不需要任何模型评估分数，显著降低了计算门槛
系统性地将三种子模函数家族（DPP、子模互信息、设施选址）应用于prompt级别的跨基准细粒度选择，并进行了大规模对比评估
构建了包含35个异构基准、5大能力类别、18个前沿LLM和61K+提示的大规模评测套件，为基准压缩研究提供了标准化评估平台
证明了设施选址（FL）函数在纯语义嵌入空间上的性能超越了12个基于分数和多样性的基线，且可同时适用于无监督和有监督两种选择场景

title: How Far Can Root Cause Analysis Go on Real-World Telemetry Data?
author: [[Athira Gopal, Ashwanth Krishnan]]
description: arXiv:2607.13548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying root causes in production microservice failures requires reasoning over large-scale, multimodal telemetry spanning metrics, logs, and traces, a problem that has proved resistant to both classical and LLM-based approaches. The OpenRCA dataset exemplifies these challenges: it is large-scale, multimodal, and lacks detailed domain knowledge, and yields consistently low accuracy across all existing methods. We show that classical causal discovery methods and existing LLM-based multi-agent systems fail to reliably identify root causes on this benchmark, and present a Structured Multi-Agent RCA pipeline that substantially outperforms existing LLM-based and classical baselines, supporting both domain-knowledge and knowledge-free operating modes. To diagnose where failures originate, we introduce a reverse reasoning agent that, given the correct answer, identifies which signals in the extracted anomalies support it and determines whether Stage~1 had access to those signals, classifying each failure as Reasoning Gap (evidence present but unused) or Data Ambiguity (evidence genuinely absent). This analysis reveals that the required evidence is present in the vast majority of failures: the bottleneck is not data access but the agent's ability to reason over it correctly. We further introduce an automated rule mining pipeline that systematically extracts discrimination rules from reverse reasoning reports, reducing reliance on manual knowledge curation. Across all configurations, model reasoning capability and domain knowledge are the primary constraints: stronger models embed more domain expertise, and explicit knowledge injection partially compensates for this gap. Reasoning performance remains practically bounded even when evidence extraction is perfect: scaffold engineering and better data pipelines alone cannot close this gap; progress requires improvements at the model level.
tldr: 一篇论文表明，在基于真实微服务遥测数据的根因分析中，经典因果发现方法和现有基于LLM的多智能体系统均表现不佳。作者提出的结构化多智能体RCA管道显著优于现有基线，并发现瓶颈在于模型的推理能力而非数据可及性，仅靠脚手架工程无法弥合这一差距。
objective_summary: 该论文利用OpenRCA数据集（大规模、多模态的微服务遥测数据，涵盖指标、日志和追踪）评估多种根因分析方法。实验表明，经典因果发现方法和现有LLM多智能体系统均无法在该基准上稳定识别根因。作者提出一种结构化多智能体RCA管道，同时支持领域知识引导和无知识两种运行模式，在OpenRCA上显著优于现有基线。通过引入反向推理智能体对失败案例进行诊断，将失败分为推理鸿沟（证据存在但未被使用）和数据歧义（证据确实缺失）两类。分析发现绝大多数故障中所需证据实际存在，瓶颈在于智能体的推理能力而非数据获取。论文还引入自动化规则挖掘管道，从反向推理报告中系统提取判别规则，减少对人工知识整理的依赖。结论指出，脚手架工程和更好的数据管道无法单独弥合推理差距，需要模型层面的进步。
key_logic_flow: 论文以OpenRCA数据集为基准，评估了经典因果发现方法和现有基于LLM的多智能体系统在真实微服务故障根因分析上的表现，发现所有现有方法均无法可靠识别根因。
作者提出结构化多智能体RCA管道（Structured Multi-Agent RCA Pipeline），支持领域知识引导和无知识两种运行模式，在OpenRCA上显著超越现有基线。
为诊断失败原因，引入反向推理智能体（Reverse Reasoning Agent），对每个失败案例判断提取的异常信号中是否包含支持正确答案的证据，将失败归类为推理鸿沟（证据存在但未被使用）或数据歧义（证据确实缺失）。
反向推理分析表明，绝大多数故障中所需证据实际存在于提取的异常信号中，瓶颈在于智能体的推理能力而非数据可及性。
论文进一步引入自动化规则挖掘管道，从反向推理报告中系统提取判别规则，降低对人工领域知识整理的依赖。
论文结论指出，即使证据提取完美，推理性能仍存在实际上限；脚手架工程和更好的数据管道无法单独弥合这一差距，进步需要模型层面能力的提升。

title: AnovaX: A Local, Multi-Agent Voice Assistant with LLM Planning, Typed Executors, and Adaptive Recovery
author: [[Raunak B Sinha]]
description: arXiv:2607.15367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Desktop voice assistants are still dominated by cloud pipelines that ship raw audio off the machine and expose a fixed set of skills. We describe AnovaX, a small local-first assistant that runs entirely on the user's computer and treats the desktop itself as its action surface. A single Python process wires together a wake-word gate, a speech pipeline, an LLM planner (Gemini) that emits a JSON plan of tool calls, a whitelist-and-denylist safety layer, a multi-agent orchestrator that translates each plan into typed child agents on a bounded thread pool, and an adaptive recovery loop that takes over whenever a core step fails. Every tool corresponds to a specialized agent class (AppAgent, TypingAgent, BrowserAgent and six others) with its own timeout, retry policy, and shared-resource locks. A recursive MetaAgent lets the planner delegate a sub-goal back to itself, capped at two levels of nesting. The recovery loop uses a compact ReAct-style prompt and hides Gemini's latency behind speculative execution of read-only tools. A companion Flask server exposes a phone-friendly remote over the local WiFi, mirrors every agent lifecycle event to the phone in real time, and streams the laptop's screen back over MJPEG so the user can watch remote commands land as they run. The point of the project is less to compete with Siri or Alexa than to show that a legible, few-thousand-line assistant is enough to open apps, type into them, run searches, coordinate concurrent actions, recover from single-step failures, and be driven entirely from a phone in another room -- without the LLM ever touching the keyboard.
tldr: AnovaX 是一个完全本地运行的多代理桌面语音助手系统，利用 Gemini LLM 进行任务规划，通过类型化子代理执行工具调用，并配备自适应恢复机制，无需将音频数据发送到云端。
objective_summary: 该论文提出了 AnovaX，一个完全在用户本地计算机上运行的桌面语音助手系统。系统通过单 Python 进程集成了唤醒词门控、语音流水线、Gemini LLM 规划器和多代理编排器，将每个 JSON 格式的计划翻译为带类型、带超时和重试策略的子代理任务。系统还包含自适应恢复循环和两级的递归 MetaAgent，并配套提供 Flask 远程控制服务器，可通过手机在本地 WiFi 内实时操控电脑。
key_logic_flow: AnovaX 是一个本地优先的桌面语音助手系统，所有处理完全在用户计算机上完成，不将原始音频发送到云端。
系统使用 Gemini 作为 LLM 规划器，生成 JSON 格式的工具调用计划，并通过白名单和黑名单安全层进行过滤。
多代理编排器将每个计划转换为带类型的子代理实例，运行在有限线程池上，每个代理有独立的超时和重试策略。
系统包含一个自适应恢复循环，该循环使用精简的 ReAct 风格提示，并在核心步骤失败时接管控制。
一个递归的 MetaAgent 允许规划器将子目标再次委托给自身，最多支持两级嵌套深度。
配套的 Flask 服务器通过本地 WiFi 提供手机远程控制界面，通过 MJPEG 流实时回传笔记本电脑屏幕。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 声称完全本地运行却依赖云端 Gemini API 的矛盾，以及几千行代码的量级能否支撑可靠的生产级桌面自动化

hype_assessment.reason: 论文技术细节扎实，提供了具体的架构设计和实现说明，不是空洞的概念炒作。但存在明显的PR包装问题：标题和摘要强调'Local'、'runs entirely on the user's computer'，实际LLM规划器却依赖Google Gemini云端API，只有音频流水线是本地处理。'本地优先'的表述虽有部分真实，但过度延伸到了整个系统，属于一定程度的包装美化。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 将类型化执行器（Typed Executors，每类代理独立超时/重试/资源锁）、自适应恢复循环（Adaptive Recovery Loop，精简ReAct风格接管失败步骤）、递归MetaAgent（子目标委派回自身，最多2级嵌套）和推测执行（Speculative Execution，在LLM推理期间预执行只读工具以隐藏延迟）等模式集成在单一Python进程内，架构设计具有工程参考价值。
domain_disruption.business_model: 无

compound_value.reason: AnovaX 的价值在于其作为'可复现的参考架构'的示范效应，而非商业产品本身。其核心贡献——本地优先设计、类型化子代理（独立超时/重试/锁）、自适应恢复循环、递归 MetaAgent——这些是多代理系统走向工程实践的关键模式验证，对开源 Agent 生态有方法论的复利效应。但限制也很明显：(1) 只是学术原型（几千行 Python），离产品级可靠性、多平台兼容性、用户体验打磨还有很大距离；(2) 依赖 Gemini API（虽说是本地编排，但 LLM 调用仍需联网），并非完全离线；(3) 多代理编排赛道已拥挤（CrewAI、AutoGen、LangGraph 等），AnovaX 缺乏差异化的商业化路径或护城河。综合来看，它的模式库价值会被更成熟的框架吸收，但自身难以独立捕获长期复利。

title: Causal-Audit: Explicit and Auditable Graph-based Reasoning via Target-Aware Causal Chain Construction
author: [[Su Lan, Xuefei Yin, Yanming Zhu, Alan Wee-Chung Liew]]
description: arXiv:2607.15281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Causal and intervention-based question answering is fundamental to advancing large language models (LLMs) toward reasoning beyond surface-level correlations and understanding underlying causal mechanisms. However, existing LLM-based methods often rely on implicit language-level reasoning, resulting in opaque causal assumptions, unverifiable reasoning paths, and fragile predictions under complex interventions, particularly in context-free settings. In this paper, we propose an explicit and auditable causal reasoning framework for context-free intervention-based question answering. Our method formulates causal inference as structured reasoning over an explicit causal graph through four modular stages, rather than implicit end-to-end prediction. A key innovation is a target-aware causal graph construction strategy that treats the target variable as a core constraint during graph expansion, effectively suppressing irrelevant variables, spurious causal relations, and reasoning noise. We further introduce a path-level causal evidence aggregation mechanism that combines multiple causal paths while modeling both reinforcing and counteracting effects, enabling robust decision-making beyond single-chain reasoning. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms existing LLM-based methods while providing interpretable and auditable causal reasoning traces.

title: Oracle Agent Memory as an Enterprise Memory Substrate for Long-Horizon AI Agents
author: [[Richmond Alake, Cesare Bernardis, Paul Cayet, Luca Engel, Damien Hilloulin, Sungpack Hong, Allen Hosler, Nickolas Kavantzas, Ingo Kossyk, Son Le, Rhicheek Patra, Kartik Talamadupula, Valentin Venzin]]
description: arXiv:2607.13157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent memory is a systems problem for long-horizon agents. Practical deployments require retention of task state across extended conversations, recovery of user-specific facts and preferences across sessions, and accumulation of procedural knowledge from prior outcomes. These requirements extend beyond document retrieval: a memory layer must determine which interactions become durable state, how that state is scoped, how it is retrieved under latency constraints, and how it is revised or removed over time. This report studies Oracle Agent Memory as a database-native memory substrate built on Oracle Database. Three themes organize the discussion: memory as a lifecycle spanning ingestion, extraction, consolidation, retrieval, summarization, and revision or removal; a layered architecture that separates an active memory core from a passive memory-store interface with explicit scope control across users, agents, and threads; and evaluation methodology in which downstream task accuracy is complemented by memory-centric measures such as evidence retrieval, recall, latency, and estimated token use. The report summarizes LongMemEval results, reaching 93.8% accuracy, compares Oracle Agent Memory against flat-history baselines, using about 10.7x fewer tokens, and published or reported external baselines where available, and closes with implementation-oriented appendix material covering setup, thread lifecycle, and search semantics.
tldr: Oracle 发布了一篇技术报告，详细介绍了 Oracle Agent Memory——一个基于 Oracle Database 构建的数据库原生记忆层系统，用于解决长周期 AI 智能体的状态持久化、事实记忆和程序知识积累问题。在 LongMemEval 基准上达到 93.8% 的准确率，相比扁平历史基线减少约 10.7 倍令牌消耗。
objective_summary: Oracle 于 2026 年 7 月在 arXiv 发表技术报告，提出 Oracle Agent Memory——一个基于 Oracle Database 构建的数据库原生记忆层系统，旨在为长周期 AI 智能体提供记忆支持。该系统将记忆管理划分为六个生命周期阶段：摄入、提取、整合、检索、摘要和修订/移除；采用分层架构，将活跃记忆核心与被动记忆存储接口分离，并通过用户、智能体和线程三个维度实现作用域控制。评估方法除下游任务准确率外，还引入了以记忆为中心的指标（证据检索、召回率、延迟、估计令牌使用量）。在 LongMemEval 基准测试中达到 93.8% 的准确率，相比扁平历史基线减少约 10.7 倍令牌使用量。
key_logic_flow: Oracle Agent Memory 是一个基于 Oracle Database 构建的数据库原生（database-native）记忆层系统，专门为长周期 AI 智能体设计。
该系统将记忆视为一个完整生命周期，涵盖摄入（ingestion）、提取（extraction）、整合（consolidation）、检索（retrieval）、摘要（summarization）和修订/移除（revision/removal）六个阶段。
系统架构采用分层设计：一个活跃记忆核心（active memory core）与一个被动记忆存储接口（passive memory-store interface）分离，并通过用户（user）、智能体（agent）和线程（thread）三个维度进行显式作用域控制。
评估方法在传统下游任务准确率之外，引入了以记忆为中心的指标，包括证据检索（evidence retrieval）、召回率（recall）、延迟（latency）和估计令牌使用量（estimated token use）。
在 LongMemEval 基准测试中，Oracle Agent Memory 达到 93.8% 的准确率，相比扁平历史基线（flat-history baselines）减少了约 10.7 倍的令牌使用量。

title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI
author: [[Christophe Parisel]]
description: arXiv:2607.09744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries. We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.
tldr: 提出最小自主权理论，将访问控制的"最小权限"原则推广到自主AI系统。
objective_summary: 研究者提出了最小自主权（least autonomy）理论，将其作为最小权限原则在自主AI系统中的泛化。该理论定义了组合爆炸半径、有向代理影响图和合谋谓词，用于衡量AI代理在企业层级中的结构化隔离和跨边界授权组合风险。
key_logic_flow: 论文指出"最小权限"原则（identity只拥有完成任务严格所需的权限）对于自主AI系统不够充分，因为AI代理不仅持有权限，还能跨工作流和系统边界组合、批准和放大这些权限。
提出"最小自主权"作为最小权限的泛化，并构建了一个形式化理论体系。
定义了组合爆炸半径 d(a,b)，使用超度量树结合保密性、完整性和控制上下文的格值标签，衡量企业层级结构中动作之间的结构化分离程度。
定义了有向代理影响图 G(θ)，弧的存在需要满足受控的共享资源写后读或保守的无向A2A通信会议条件，以及不低于外部选定策略阈值θ的影响力条件。
定义了基于图可达性的合谋谓词，用于检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨领域能力组合三种风险模式。
提出了目录-半径配置文件（catalogue-radius profile）机制，用于校准和审计策略阈值θ。

paper_metadata.title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI

research_problem.core_question: 如何将访问控制中的最小权限原则泛化为适用于自主 AI 系统的'最小自主'原则，并为其建立形式化理论基础？
research_problem.motivation: 传统安全领域的最小权限原则（Least Privilege）要求身份仅持有严格必需的权限。然而，自主 AI 系统不仅仅持有权限，还能够跨工作流和系统边界组合、审批和放大权限。这种组合能力使得传统最小权限原则不足以应对 AI 代理带来的安全风险——一个被授予有限权限的 AI 代理可能通过与其他代理协作或组合授权来间接获得超出预期的能力。因此需要一种新的形式化框架来量化、约束和审计 AI 系统的自主性范围。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了传统最小权限原则无法处理 AI 代理间权限组合、跨域能力合成和决策操纵的理论空白，为 agentic AI 系统的安全约束提供了首个形式化框架。

methodology.approach_summary: 该论文提出了'最小自主'（Least Autonomy）原则作为最小权限原则的泛化，并构建了一个三组分的形式化理论体系：（1）定义了一个组合爆炸半径函数 d(a,b)，利用超度量树与格值机密性、完整性和控制上下文标签来度量企业层级中动作之间的结构分离程度；（2）定义了一个有向代理影响力图 G(θ)，其中边的存在取决于有向共享资源写-读关系或保守的无向代理间通信会议，以及超过策略阈值 θ 的影响力势；（3）定义了一个基于图可达性的共谋谓词，用于检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力合成。整个框架通过目录半径配置文件（catalogue-radius profile）支持 θ 的校准与审计。
key_innovations: 提出'最小自主'原则作为最小权限原则在 agentic AI 场景下的自然泛化，将关注点从静态权限持有扩展到动态动作组合
构建了组合爆炸半径 d(a,b) 这一形式度量，融合超度量树与格值标签体系，能量化企业层级中动作间的结构性分离程度
设计了带策略阈值 θ 的有向代理影响力图和基于图可达性的共谋谓词，可形式化检测授权组合、决策操纵与跨域能力合成三类安全风险

title: Networked Intelligence: Active Shared Context Graphs for Human-AI Team Science
author: [[Sutanay Choudhury, Jeffrey J. Czajka, Lummy M. O. Monteiro, Erin Bredeweg, Jason McDermott, Katherine Wolf, Alex Beliaev, Josh Elmore, Paul Piehowski, Kylee Tate, Yuqian Gao, Aivett Bilbao, Kelly Stratton, Scott Baker, Jaydeep P. Bardhan, Kristin Burnum Johnson, Chris Oehmen, Robert Rallo]]
description: arXiv:2607.13220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most AI-for-science systems focus on scaling a single reasoning process through better models, larger context windows, long-horizon agentic execution, or digital co-scientists working with one principal user. However, challenging scientific problems are rarely solved by one reasoner alone. They are solved by teams whose members bring different priors, experimental backgrounds, tacit knowledge, and domain-trained intuitions. The open problem is therefore not only how to scale models, but how to cultivate networked intelligence: scaling the connections between humans and AI systems so that a result or hypothesis produced in one context reaches another person, agent, instrument, or robot that can act on it. We introduce Mycelium, an active shared workspace that automatically connects researchers and AI agents as a multi-user co-scientist. As human users and agents work, the system captures important observations and hypotheses, tracks how they relate to the team's evolving model, and routes them to the person or agent whose next decision they can inform. We evaluate Mycelium in its first empirical test, a biological multi-omics campaign in which routed shared context turned a local analytical finding into a cross-expert mechanistic constraint and ultimately into an experimental design. We also give networked intelligence a computational account as sparse conditional computation over distributed scientific contexts. This account distinguishes when a scaled standalone agent can match the network from when independent expertise and non-mergeable contexts make the network irreducible.

title: Learning Safe Agent Behaviour from Human Preferences and Justifications via World Models
author: [[Ilias Kazantzidis, Timothy J. Norman, Yali Du, Christopher T. Freeman]]
description: arXiv:2607.13172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We address the problem of safely training an agent policy and deploying a good and safe policy, in settings where the environment dynamics are unknown and no suitable reward function is available. In the context of safety-critical environments, we consider traditional reinforcement learning impractical and resort to the resource of human input. We introduce DROPJ, a human-centred method for both safe training and deployment. We first learn a world model (a learned simulator) from a dataset of prior real-world trajectories. A human then plays the game in this learned simulator to extract several informative simulated trajectories. From these, we sample pairs of simulated trajectory segments and elicit from a human their preference over these segments, as well as a reason (justification) for their choice. We then train a reward model from these justified preferences and use it, together with the world model, to directly deploy the agent using model predictive control. Running real-user experiments, we find that generating informative simulated trajectories from a user significantly reduces the computational cost during training compared to other strategies, and can also improve the performance during deployment. In the context of training within a learned simulator, we show that the use of preferences rather than other types of feedback substantially improves the performance during deployment. We further demonstrate that safety justifications accompanying preferences can significantly enhance safety or prioritise user-prescribed aspects of safety associated with them during deployment.
tldr: arXiv 论文提出 DROPJ 方法，通过人类偏好与安全理由在学到的世界模型中训练安全智能体策略，利用模型预测控制直接部署，实验表明偏好反馈结合安全理由能显著提升部署安全性和性能。
objective_summary: 该论文针对环境动态未知且缺乏合适奖励函数的安全关键场景，提出了一种名为 DROPJ 的以人为本的安全训练与部署方法。该方法首先从真实轨迹数据集中学习一个世界模型（模拟器），由人类在该模拟器中交互生成信息丰富的模拟轨迹，然后从中采样轨迹片段对并收集人类的偏好选择及其理由（justification）。DROPJ 利用这些带理由的偏好训练奖励模型，再结合世界模型通过模型预测控制（MPC）直接部署智能体。真实用户实验表明，从用户生成的信息模拟轨迹相比其他策略显著降低了训练计算成本，并在部署阶段提升了性能；偏好反馈相比其他反馈类型显著提升了部署性能；安全理由则能显著增强安全行为或优先考虑用户指定的安全维度。
key_logic_flow: 论文针对安全关键环境中环境动态未知且缺乏合适奖励函数的问题，提出 DROPJ 方法以替代传统强化学习。

object_insights.positioning: DROPJ 是一种以人为本的安全智能体训练与部署方法，通过从真实轨迹学习世界模型（模拟器），让人类在模拟器中交互生成信息丰富的轨迹，再收集人类偏好选择及其安全理由来训练奖励模型，最终结合世界模型通过模型预测控制（MPC）直接部署智能体策略，适用于环境动态未知且缺乏合适奖励函数的安全关键场景。

title: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate
author: [[Suyash Mishra]]
description: arXiv:2607.09706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models turn a worded situation into a numeric plan, and the dominant pipelines (NL4Opt, OptiMUS, ORLM, OR-LLM-Agent) commit to a single objective and point-valued coefficients, then solve once. For decisions that allocate real budget, effort, or clinical attention, that confidence is the failure mode: every objectified number is an assumption, and a plan optimal only if the guesses are exactly right is fragile -- mimicry of computation. YUKTI changes the target of autoformulation. Its representation is a typed-proposition graph whose relationships carry shape priors, coefficient uncertainty, and provenance. YUKTI routes each stage to an exact, nonlinear, or evolutionary solver; couples stages by a distributional Pareto hand-off; and introduces Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers (ARPF), resampling assumptions (including structural epsilon-contamination) to score how often each action survives (rho). We prove a bound making rho an exact factor of decision regret, add auditable traceability, and synthesize a benchmark-faithful data foundation when none exists (SRJANA). We validate three ways: under controlled misspecification the robust compromise cuts mean and tail regret by over 90% versus a naive point plan; on a regulated commercial decision we optimize inside a lawful action space and price the downside in euros; and on a real public dataset of 41,188 decisions an out-of-sample backtest beats the logged status quo by 34% and a naive point rule by 4% while reducing the optimizer's curse. The solvers are standard; we claim no benchmark-SOTA win. A head-to-head shows an LLM given the correct numbers, and single-objective optimization, both incur about 47x the held-out regret of YUKTI -- an LLM is a formulator, not a solver. Under long-range causal coupling, the forward hand-off becomes unsound, locating where it must become a backward-induction causal policy.
tldr: YUKTI 提出一种从自然语言描述到鲁棒可验证决策的框架，采用类型化命题图和假设鲁棒帕累托前沿，在多项验证中将决策遗憾降低超过 90%。
objective_summary: YUKTI 框架由研究团队提出，旨在解决现有 LLM 决策管线（如 NL4Opt、OptiMUS）因采用单一目标和点值系数而导致的决策脆弱性问题。该框架使用类型化命题图表示决策问题，引入假设鲁棒帕累托前沿（ARPF）评估行动在不同假设下的幸存概率，并证明了 rho 值与决策遗憾之间的精确关系。在受控错配测试、受监管商业决策和包含 41,188 个真实决策的公共数据集上，YUKTI 相比朴素基线方案将均值与尾部遗憾降低超过 90%，并在真实数据集上超越现状决策 34%。
key_logic_flow: 现有的 NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM、OR-LLM-Agent 等决策管线采用单一目标和点值系数进行单次求解，导致方案对假设错误高度脆弱。
YUKTI 使用类型化命题图（typed-proposition graph）来表示自然语言情境中的决策问题，并在关系上附加形状先验、系数不确定性和来源追踪信息。
YUKTI 将不同求解阶段路由到精确求解器、非线性求解器或进化求解器，并通过分布帕累托交接来耦合各阶段。
YUKTI 引入假设鲁棒帕累托前沿（ARPF），通过重采样假设（包括结构 ε-污染）计算每个行动在不确定性下的幸存频率 rho，并证明 rho 是决策遗憾的精确因子。
在受控错配测试中 YUKTI 的鲁棒折中方案相比朴素点估计方案将均值与尾部遗憾降低超过 90%，在受监管商业决策中优化了合法行动空间内方案并量化了欧元计价的 downside 风险。
在包含 41,188 个决策的真实数据集上，YUKTI 的样本外回测超越现状决策 34%，而给定正确数值的 LLM 和单目标优化均产生约 47 倍的持有期遗憾。

paper_metadata.title: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate

research_problem.core_question: 如何将自然语言描述的情境转化为鲁棒且可验证的决策，而非仅仅依赖单一点估计进行确定性优化？
research_problem.motivation: 当前基于LLM的自动形式化管线（NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM、OR-LLM-Agent）在处理自然语言决策问题时，会提取单一目标函数和点估计参数然后求解一次。这种范式在真实预算分配、临床资源分配等场景中本质上是脆弱的——每一个被物化的数字都隐含着一个假设，只有在所有猜测都精确无误时方案才真正最优。确定性优化在不确定环境下只是'计算的模仿'而非真正的决策推理。亟需一种能够保留不确定性、提供鲁棒性保证的全新自动形式化范式。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 现有LLM驱动的自动形式化管线完全缺乏不确定性建模和鲁棒性验证机制，无法区分'对点估计而言的最优解'和'在假设扰动下依然可靠的决策'之间的本质区别，且没有任何理论保证来量化决策的遗憾上界。

methodology.approach_summary: YUKTI提出了一种全新的自动形式化框架，核心表示是带不确定性类型的命题图（typed-proposition graph），其中关系携带形状先验、系数不确定性和来源追踪。YUKTI将每个子问题路由到精确求解器、非线性求解器或进化求解器，通过分布化Pareto交接实现阶段耦合。核心创新是假设鲁棒Pareto前沿（ARPF），通过重采样假设（包括结构ε-污染）来量化每个行动在各种假设下的存活频率（rho），并证明了rho是决策遗憾的精确因子（Regret Certificate）。系统还包含SRJANA数据合成框架，在缺乏真实基准时生成保真度高的评测数据，并提供了完整的可审计溯源链。
key_innovations: 提出带不确定性类型的命题图表示（Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR），保留从自然语言提取过程中的所有不确定性信息而非坍缩为点估计，从根本上改变了自动形式化的表示范式
引入假设鲁棒Pareto前沿（ARPF），通过重采样假设分布（含结构ε-污染）量化每个决策行动的鲁棒性得分（rho），将鲁棒优化思想引入自然语言决策管线
证明rho是决策遗憾的精确因子（proved bound），为决策鲁棒性提供了严格的理论保证——这是该领域首个形式化的遗憾界
提出SRJANA数据合成框架，在缺乏真实基准时生成保真度高的评测数据，解决了鲁棒决策领域缺乏统一基准的痛点
inspiration_sources: 鲁棒优化理论（Robust Optimization）
Pareto前沿与多目标优化（Multi-objective Optimization）
不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification）
结构ε-污染模型（Structural Epsilon-Contamination）
LLM驱动的自动形式化管线（NL4Opt, OptiMUS, ORLM）

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 三重验证策略：（1）受控误设定实验——系统性地误设目标函数系数，比较鲁棒折中方案与朴素点方案的均值和尾部遗憾；（2）受监管商业决策场景——在法律约束的行动空间中优化并以欧元量化最坏情况损失；（3）大规模样本外回溯测试——使用包含41188个真实决策的公开数据集验证方法有效性。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 在受控误设定下，鲁棒折中方案相比朴素点方案将均值和尾部遗憾降低90%以上；在41188个真实决策的样本外回溯测试中，比记录状态提升34%，比朴素点规则提升4%，同时减少了优化者诅咒（optimizer's curse）；LLM给定正确数字和单目标优化均产生约47倍于YUKTI的持有外遗憾。

stated_limitations: 当存在长程因果耦合时，前向分布化Pareto交接变得不可靠，需要退化为反向归纳因果策略

ARPF的重采样策略（包括ε-污染的具体取值）如何选择？是否存在对超参数选择的敏感性？
与其他鲁棒优化方法（如分布鲁棒优化、模糊集方法、贝叶斯优化）的直接对比不够充分

related_work_context.advancement_over_prior: 现有管线（NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM等）的核心范式是从自然语言中提取单一目标函数和点估计参数后直接求解最优解。YUKTI从根本上改变了这一范式：它不再将不确定性视为需要消除的噪声，而是将其显式建模为命题图的一部分，并通过ARPF对所有假设进行系统性重采样来评估决策的鲁棒性。这不仅在实验中实现了90%以上的遗憾降低，还通过Regret Certificate提供了严格的理论保证——这是所有现有工作完全缺失的。更关键的是，YUKTI明确了LLM的角色边界——LLM是形式化器而非求解器——纠正了领域内对LLM求解能力的过度自信，单目标优化被指出本质上是一种'计算的模仿'。

title: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking
author: [[Deep Pankajbhai Mehta]]
description: arXiv:2607.09665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prompt wrappers often differ only in formatting, yet they can change model scores enough to flip leaderboard conclusions. We study this variance under a token-controlled protocol and introduce two complementary metrics: the Format Sensitivity Index (FSI), the accuracy range induced by wrapper choice, and the Parseability Sensitivity Index (PSI), the corresponding range in answer parseability. Across 140,000 OpenRouter generations spanning 7 QA tasks, 5 wrapper families, and 4 instruct models from 7B to 72B parameters, we find that mean FSI varies by over 30x across models and is largely explained by compliance failures. A fixed-effects regression shows that parseability remains a strong predictor of accuracy even after controlling for task, model, and wrapper. We argue that reporting accuracy without wrapper variance and compliance is statistically fragile, and we give practical recommendations for both benchmarking and structured-output deployments.
tldr: 研究提示词包装器格式差异对LLM评测结果的影响，提出FSI和PSI两个量化指标，发现平均FSI跨模型差异超30倍。
objective_summary: 研究人员在140,000次OpenRouter生成测试中，跨7个QA任务、5种包装器族和4种指令模型（7B-72B参数），发现平均FSI跨模型差异超过30倍，主要由格式合规失败解释。固定效应回归显示可解析性是准确率的强预测因子。
key_logic_flow: 提示词包装器在格式上的微小差异可能导致模型得分产生足以翻转排行榜结论的变化。
论文提出两个互补指标：格式敏感指数（FSI）衡量准确率波动范围，可解析性敏感指数（PSI）衡量答案可解析性的波动范围。
在140,000次OpenRouter生成测试中，跨7个QA任务、5种包装器族和4种指令模型（7B-72B参数）进行实验。
平均FSI在不同模型间差异超过30倍，主要由格式合规失败导致。
固定效应回归显示，即使控制任务、模型和包装器后，可解析性仍是准确率的强预测因子。
论文主张在评测中报告准确率时若不考虑包装器方差和合规性，统计结果具有脆弱性。

paper_metadata.title: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking

research_problem.core_question: 提示模板的格式变化在多大程度上影响LLM的基准测试得分，以及如何量化这种格式敏感度？
research_problem.motivation: 在LLM基准测试中，仅存在格式差异的提示包装器（如不同的分隔符、标记结构等）即可导致模型得分发生足以翻转排行榜结论的变化。然而，现有基准测试报告仅报告单一准确率指标，完全忽略提示格式引入的方差和答案可解析性差异，导致统计结论脆弱且不可靠。亟需系统性量化和标准化这种格式敏感度。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了LLM基准测试方法论中缺乏格式方差量化指标的空白——现有工作仅关注提示内容设计，忽略格式变化带来的统计脆弱性，且缺乏统一的指标来评估和报告这种敏感度。

methodology.approach_summary: 提出了一套系统性评估LLM对提示格式变化敏感程度的方法。引入两个互补指标：格式敏感指数(FSI，衡量不同包装器下准确率的波动范围)和可解析性敏感指数(PSI，衡量答案可解析性的相应波动范围)。在token级别受控协议下，通过系统的格式变体生成实验设计，隔离格式变量对模型输出的影响。在140,000次OpenRouter API调用、7个QA任务、5种包装器家族和4种指令模型(7B-72B参数)上开展大规模实证研究，并使用固定效应回归分析可解析性与准确率的因果关系。
key_innovations: 提出FSI和PSI两个互补指标，首次系统量化提示格式变化对LLM基准测试得分的影响及其统计显著性
通过token级别受控协议隔离格式变量，揭示不同模型间格式敏感度存在超过30倍的巨大差异，且主要由合规失败(c)解释
使用固定效应回归方法证明可解析性是准确率的强预测因子，即使在控制任务、模型、包装器变量后仍然成立

title: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare
author: [[actAVA AI,  :, Haolin Chen, Leon Qi, Steve Brown, Deon Metelski, Tao Xia, Joonyul Lee, Qixuan Wang, Kevin Riley, Frank Wang, Weiran Yao]]
description: arXiv:2607.15314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Healthcare spans high-stakes communication, expert reasoning, and workflow execution, yet specialized LLMs that cover these use cases together remain limited. A healthcare model must handle patient consultation, clinical reasoning over text and images, interactive diagnosis, and electronic health record (EHR) tool use. These capabilities fail in different ways, and a narrow update for one task can degrade another. We present Cura 1T, a healthcare-specialized LLM trained through a human-gated self-evolution loop. In each evolution round, a training agent plans a target capability, trains the model, evaluates benchmark trajectories, and refines the data mixture from observed failures. This data-centered loop improves the model through targeted synthetic and curated examples rather than a single generic medical-data update. Across the healthcare evaluation suite, Cura 1T ranks at or near the top among frontier baselines, while remaining competitive on out-of-domain reasoning and agentic benchmarks.
tldr: Cura 1T 是一个面向智能医疗的专用大语言模型，通过人工介入的自我进化循环进行训练，在医疗评估套件中达到或接近前沿基线水平，同时在通用推理和智能体基准测试中保持竞争力。
objective_summary: Cura 1T 是一款医疗专用大语言模型，由团队通过人工介入的自我进化循环（human-gated self-evolution loop）训练而成。在每个进化轮次中，训练智能体规划目标能力、训练模型、评估基准轨迹并根据观察到的失败来优化数据混合策略。该模型覆盖患者咨询、图文临床推理、交互式诊断和电子健康记录（EHR）工具使用等能力。在医疗评估套件中，Cura 1T 排名达到或接近前沿基线水平，并在领域外推理和智能体基准测试上同样表现良好。
key_logic_flow: Cura 1T 是一个面向智能医疗场景的专用大语言模型，使用人工介入的自我进化循环进行训练。

title: Do Coding Agents Need Executable World Models, Simplification, and Verification to Solve ARC-AGI-3?
author: [[Sergey Rodionov]]
description: arXiv:2607.15439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Our previous ARC-AGI-3 agent bundled executable world modeling, scheduled simplification, and exact replay verification, leaving unclear which idea accounted for its performance. We address this attribution question with four nested Codex-based agents: a textual baseline; a flexible-interface executable world model without replay verification; the same executable model with scheduled simplification; and a fixed-interface verification treatment that retains simplification and requires exact reproduction of recorded observations. The main study evaluates all four agents with gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 at high and xhigh reasoning effort on the public ARC-AGI-3 games. Exploratory follow-ups evaluate the textual and verification variants with gpt-5.6-sol at xhigh and max. The most robust result is that every agent variant improves with a stronger model and with greater reasoning effort. Within each model-effort setting, differences among variants are smaller than anticipated, while the effects of individual components vary across settings. Requiring a persistent executable deliverable is not universally beneficial: the textual variant outperforms the flexible-interface executable variant in both gpt-5.5 settings. Simplification improves performance in three of the four model-effort settings, with the weakest setting as the only exception. The complete verification treatment ranks first in all four settings, although it uses substantially more resources. In the gpt-5.6-sol follow-up, the verification variant fully solves every public game at both reasoning efforts, achieves about 99% RHAE, and uses fewer than half the total actions of the human baseline. Because the model postdates these games and held-out performance remains untested, this result should be interpreted as saturation of the public set only.
tldr: 该论文通过四个嵌套的Codex智能体变体，系统归因了可执行世界建模、简化机制和验证机制在ARC-AGI-3任务上的各自贡献。完整验证变体在所有模型和推理努力设置中排名第一，在gpt-5.6-sol上以不到人类基线一半的动作数完全解决了所有公开游戏。
objective_summary: 该研究设计了四种基于Codex的智能体变体（文本基线、灵活接口可执行世界模型无回放验证、带调度简化机制的可执行世界模型、固定接口完整验证变体），在gpt-5.4和gpt-5.5的高与极高推理努力设置下，以及gpt-5.6-sol的后续实验中，评估它们在公开ARC-AGI-3游戏上的表现。结果显示更强模型和更高推理努力始终提升所有变体性能，但变体间差异小于预期。完整验证变体在所有设置中排名第一，但消耗显著更多资源；在gpt-5.6-sol上完全解决所有公开游戏并达到约99%的RHAE。
key_logic_flow: 作者之前的ARC-AGI-3智能体同时集成了可执行世界建模、调度简化机制和精确回放验证，但各组件贡献不明确。
本研究设计了四种嵌套的Codex智能体变体：文本基线、无验证的可执行世界模型、带简化的可执行模型、以及完整验证变体。
在gpt-5.4和gpt-5.5上的主实验表明，更强模型和更高推理努力始终提升所有变体的性能。
文本基线在gpt-5.5设置下反而优于灵活接口的可执行变体，说明持久化可执行交付物并非普遍有益。
完整验证变体在所有四种模型-努力设置中排名第一，但消耗的资源远超其他变体。
在gpt-5.6-sol的后续实验中，验证变体以不到人类基线一半的动作数完全解决所有公开游戏，约99% RHAE，但该结果应视为公开集的饱和而非泛化能力。

title: Interventional Grounding Audits: Black-Box Premise-Dependency Tests for LLM Chain-of-Thought via Predicate Substitution
author: [[Hironao Nakamura]]
description: arXiv:2607.13069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models produce chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that appears logically sound yet may not genuinely depend on its stated premises. We introduce interventional grounding audits, a black-box, step-level test of premise dependency: we intervene on a single premise by substituting its target predicate with a fresh symbol, re-run the model, and check whether each reasoning step's normalized conclusion (canonical predicate form) changes. We evaluate on ProntoQA, a synthetic multi-hop deductive reasoning benchmark with gold proof trees, where step-level premise dependencies are known. Applied to 50 ProntoQA problems with GPT-4o, our method achieves F1 = 0.806 on detecting proof-tree dependencies (F1 = 0.885 on predicate-determining dependencies; Recall = 100%), significantly outperforming a self-consistency baseline (F1 = 0.343; 95% bootstrap CIs non-overlapping). We further identify that 66% of correctly-solved problems contain at least one aligned step insensitive to a direct proof-tree dependency under consistent substitution -- all involving entity-introduction premises, a documented blind spot of the consistent-substitution evaluator -- a "right answer, wrong reasoning" signal invisible to passive methods. All audit certificates, raw outputs, and reproduction scripts are available in a public GitHub repository, and we discuss scope limits beyond formal, parsable benchmarks.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为"干预式接地审计"的黑盒方法，通过谓词替换测试大语言模型思维链推理是否真正依赖其陈述的前提。在ProntoQA基准上使用GPT-4o测试，该方法在检测证明树依赖关系上F1=0.806，显著优于自一致性基线（F1=0.343），并发现66%正确解答的问题中存在"答对但推理错误"的信号。
objective_summary: 研究人员提出了一种黑盒、步骤级别的干预式接地审计方法，用于检验大语言模型思维链推理对其前提的真实依赖程度。该方法通过替换单个前提中的目标谓词为全新符号后重新运行模型，检查每个推理步骤的归一化结论是否发生变化。在ProntoQA合成多跳演绎推理基准上使用GPT-4o进行50道题测试，该方法检测证明树依赖的F1值为0.806（谓词决定性依赖的F1值为0.885，召回率100%），远超自一致性基线（F1=0.343，95%自助法置信区间无重叠）。研究发现66%被正确解答的问题中至少存在一个对齐步骤对直接证明树依赖不敏感，揭示了被动方法无法发现的"答对但推理错误"现象。
key_logic_flow: 论文指出大语言模型产出的思维链推理表面看似逻辑合理，但可能并未真正依赖其陈述的前提。
作者提出干预式接地审计方法：对单个前提进行谓词替换（将目标谓词替换为全新符号），重新运行模型后检查每个推理步骤的归一化结论是否变化。
该方法在ProntoQA合成多跳演绎推理基准上使用GPT-4o进行验证，检测证明树依赖的F1值为0.806。
与传统被动审计方法（如自一致性检测，F1=0.343）相比，干预式接地审计在统计上显著更优。
研究发现了"答对但推理错误"现象：66%正确解答的问题中存在至少一个对齐步骤对直接证明树依赖不敏感，主要涉及实体引入前提。
论文讨论了该方法的形式化适用范围限制，所有审计证书、原始输出和复现脚本已公开在GitHub仓库中。

title: LAPO: Leave-One-Turn Attribution for Self-Generated Process Rewards in Multi-Turn Search Reasoning
author: [[Qiang Zhu, Jiajun Wu]]
description: arXiv:2607.13501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn search reasoning typically relies on terminal outcome rewards, which cannot distinguish useful, redundant, and harmful intermediate interactions. We propose LAPO, a self-generated process-supervision method based on backward leave-one-turn attribution. For each search turn, LAPO replaces the turn and its retrieval observation with a fixed [DELETE] placeholder and measures the resulting change in the current policy's mean log-likelihood of the gold answer. This Answer-Likelihood Gain estimates the turn's contribution while preserving all downstream interactions, allowing early evidence to be evaluated in the complete reasoning context. LAPO further applies sign-consistency gating, retaining only normalized process advantages whose directions agree with their raw attribution scores. The method requires no additional reward model, teacher, verifier, or LLM-as-a-Judge. Across seven knowledge-intensive question-answering datasets with local retrieval, LAPO achieves an average exact-match score of 0.326, outperforming the strongest step-reward baseline, IGPO, by 0.053. Ablations show complementary benefits from backward attribution and sign-consistency gating, demonstrating that policy-derived retrospective attribution can provide effective process supervision for multi-turn search agents.
tldr: LAPO 是一种基于留一法反向归因的自生成过程奖励方法，用于多轮搜索推理的强化学习，无需额外奖励模型，在七个知识密集型问答数据集上平均精确匹配得分为 0.326，优于最强基线 IGPO 的 0.053。
objective_summary: 研究者提出 LAPO（留一法反向归因）方法，通过将每一轮搜索替换为固定 [DELETE] 占位符并测量当前策略对正确答案的平均对数似然变化，估算每轮搜索的贡献度。该方法不需要额外的奖励模型、教师模型或 LLM 作为评判器，完全由策略自身提供回溯性归因信号。在七个知识密集型问答数据集上的实验表明，LAPO 的平均精确匹配得分为 0.326，超过最强步骤奖励基线 IGPO 的 0.053。消融实验验证了反向归因和符号一致性门控的互补优势。
key_logic_flow: 多轮搜索推理的强化学习通常只依赖终端结果奖励，无法区分有用、冗余和有害的中间交互步骤。
LAPO 提出基于留一法反向归因的自生成过程监督方法，将每轮搜索及其检索结果替换为固定 [DELETE] 占位符，并测量当前策略对正确答案的平均对数似然变化作为贡献度估计。
该方法使用答案似然增益来估算每轮搜索的贡献，同时保留所有下游交互上下文，使早期证据也能在完整推理链条中得到评估。
LAPO 采用符号一致性门控机制，只保留原始归因分数与处理后优势方向一致的归一化过程优势。
该方法不需要额外的奖励模型、教师模型、验证器或 LLM 作为评判器，完全由策略自身生成过程监督信号。
在七个知识密集型问答数据集上，LAPO 的平均精确匹配得分为 0.326，优于最强步骤奖励基线 IGPO 的 0.053，消融实验验证了反向归因与符号一致性门控的互补效果。

title: NeurOWL: An LLM-Based Neural-symbolic Framework for Incomplete OWL Ontology Reasoning
author: [[Hui Yang, Jiaoyan Chen, Yiping Song, Renate Schmidt, Wen Zhang]]
description: arXiv:2607.15776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: OWL ontologies provide a formal knowledge representation framework that enables semantic reasoning, and have been widely adopted across domains such as healthcare and bioinformatics. In practice, however, real-world ontologies are often incomplete, which pose challenges for reasoning. In this work, we focus on a fundamental subsumption reasoning problem: given an incomplete ontology and a candidate (non-entailed) subsumption, determine whether the subsumption is semantically plausible and, if so, providing a logically sound explanation containing potential missing axioms. This task unifies subsumption verification with ontology abduction, and generalizes the latter by removing the need for a predefined candidate set of missing axioms. To address this subsumption reasoning problem, we propose NeurOWL, an end-to-end neuro-symbolic framework that jointly performs verification and abduction, leveraging both formally defined semantics and textual semantics through Large Language Models and ontology embeddings. We evaluate NeurOWL on real-world ontologies across multiple domains, demonstrating strong and robust performance across different domains.

objective_summary: 该论文针对不完整OWL本体论中的子集推理问题，提出NeurOWL框架，统一了子集关系验证与本体溯因两个任务。NeurOWL通过大语言模型和本体嵌入，同时利用形式化语义与文本语义进行推理，在医疗、生物信息学等多个领域的真实本体论上完成评估，展现出强且鲁棒的跨领域性能。

该研究针对不完整本体论场景下的子集推理问题，要求同时判断候选子集关系的语义合理性并提供逻辑解释。

title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems
author: [[Jun He, Deying Yu]]
description: arXiv:2607.09748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In distributed systems, the classical State Machine Replication (SMR) model assumes that correct replicas execute deterministic transitions to yield identical bitwise states. However, the rise of agentic distributed systems -- where autonomous, stochastic, and model-driven agents orchestrate infrastructure -- presents scenarios where deterministic, bitwise replication is insufficient. Replicas operating with generative models may exhibit divergent reasoning paths, summaries, and token boundaries, yet reach semantically equivalent and correct operational decisions. Forcing bitwise agreement across these stochastic participants degrades execution flexibility, induces context amnesia, and limits performance. We argue that in such settings replicas should agree on belief, not bits. We propose Epistemic State Replication (ESR), a belief-replication layer for agentic distributed systems that shifts the replication boundary from data visibility to knowledge visibility. We formalize the epistemic node state as a pair K = (L, B) separating the deterministic, immutable evidence log (L) from the stochastic, evolving belief lineage (B). To govern execution safety, we define Semantic Linearizability, which requires operations to reflect the latest committed operational meaning within a verifier-bounded semantic compatibility metric, and Bounded Eventual Coherence, which bounds expected semantic divergence under fair delivery, monotonic evidence, bounded verifier disturbance, and a contractive graft operator. We outline protocols for propagating derived insights using structured epistemic deltas, and formalize Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks to prune faulty premises from belief lineages without inducing context amnesia. We prototype ESR and report preliminary simulation results that show feasibility under the stated assumptions and illustrate reductions in secondary cognitive faults.
tldr: 提出信念状态复制（ESR），将智能体分布式系统的复制边界从数据可见性移至知识可见性。

paper_metadata.title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems

research_problem.core_question: 在基于生成式模型的智能体分布式系统中，如何设计一种超越经典状态机复制（SMR）的复制协议，使副本间达成语义一致的信念状态而非严格的比特级一致？
research_problem.motivation: 随着AI智能体系统在分布式基础设施编排中的广泛应用，传统的状态机复制（SMR）要求副本执行确定性转换以获得比特级一致的状态。然而，基于生成模型（如LLM）的智能体存在随机推理路径、摘要差异和token边界分歧，强求比特级一致不仅限制了执行灵活性，还会导致上下文遗忘（context amnesia）并严重损害性能。这一根本矛盾在现有的分布式系统理论中缺乏解决方案。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 现有SMR模型要求副本间保持严格的比特级状态一致，无法适应基于生成式模型的智能体系统中推理路径的随机性、语义等价但形式不同的输出、以及上下文连续性需求之间的根本矛盾。分布式系统理论缺少一种允许副本在语义层面达成一致、同时在表示层面容忍差异的复制范式。

methodology.approach_summary: ESR提出了一种信念级复制层，将副本节点状态分解为两个独立组件：确定性不可变的证据日志（L）和随机演化的信念谱系（B）。L记录不可篡改的原始事实与操作，B存储基于证据推导出的认知状态及其演化历史。为约束系统行为，论文形式化定义了语义线性化（Semantic Linearizability），要求操作反映最新的已提交操作语义含义，并通过有界验证器（verifier）在语义兼容性度量内确保正确性；同时定义了有界最终一致性（Bounded Eventual Coherence），在公平投递、单调证据、有界验证器扰动和收缩性嫁接算子条件下约束语义发散的上界。协议使用结构化的认知增量（epistemic deltas）传播衍生见解，并通过可验证语义回滚（Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks）从信念谱系中剪除错误前提而不引发上下文遗忘。
key_innovations: 提出Epistemic State Replication（ESR）范式，将复制边界从数据可见性迁移到知识可见性，从根本上重新定义了分布式系统在AI智能体时代的一致性质
形式化定义语义线性化（Semantic Linearizability）和有界最终一致性（Bounded Eventual Coherence）两种新的一致性模型，为基于信念的复制提供了严格的数学基础
提出可验证语义回滚（Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks）机制，在不引发上下文遗忘的前提下从信念谱系中剪除错误前提，解决了经典SMR回滚操作在智能体系统中的适用性问题

limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 当前形式化框架对验证器（verifier）的语义兼容性度量能力有强依赖，若验证器本身存在偏见或能力不足以覆盖所有语义等价情形，则整个协议的 correctness 保证可能退化。模型关键假设（公平投递、单调证据、收缩性嫁接算子）在不可靠网络、拜占庭故障节点或恶意攻击场景下可能被违反，协议在这些非理想条件下的行为缺乏分析。此外，信念谱系在不同类型智能体（如基于不同基础模型的LLM代理）之间的兼容性尚未探讨。

industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: ESR通过减少不必要的比特级同步，理论上可降低通信带宽消耗和计算冗余，尤其在智能体推理开销占主导的场景下优势明显。但引入语义验证器和认知增量传播机制带来了额外的计算和通信成本——每次操作都需要通过验证器判断语义兼容性，验证器本身的推理开销可能显著。当前缺乏端到端的定量成本效益分析，无法判断在何种规模和应用场景下ESR的净收益为正。

title: Probabilistic Extension of Neuro-Symbolic AGI Robots based on Belnap's Typed Intensional FOL
author: [[Zoran Majkic]]
description: arXiv:2607.13073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neuro-symbolic AI based on $IFOL_B$ is a way to combine neural learning and symbolic reasoning to overcome limitations of purely neural systems (like lack of interpretability and logical structure) with formal logical machinery for self-reference. In this paper we expand the cognitive power of $IFOL_B$ by using the probability computation for the currently unknown sentences, based on Nilsson's probability structure for the $IFOL_B$. We introduce the global symmetry transformation that preserves the current knowledge database and logical deduction, and the local one used for real-time decisions about concrete (sub)problems that involve only a very strict subset of $IFOL_B$ predicates. The computation of probability density function $KI$ in both cases, based on the Shannon's maximum information entropy, is provided by neural networks of this probabilistic neuro-symbolic AGI.

title: DrawingVQA: A Real-World Benchmark for Multi-Depth Visual-Textual Reasoning on Construction Drawings
author: [[Yoonhwa Jung, Junryu Fu, Mani Golparvar-Fard]]
description: arXiv:2607.15418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce DrawingVQA, the first benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on real-world construction drawings -- a core media in architecture, civil, and many other engineering practices. Unlike natural images or schematic floor plans, construction drawings fuse abstract geometry, symbolic notation, tabular data, annotations, and domain-specific text, forming a uniquely complex visual-textual domain core to engineering workflows. DrawingVQA bridges this gap with 33 "Issued for Construction" drawings and 92 expertly curated question-answer pairs, spanning three reasoning depths: perceptual understanding, contextual interpretation, and domain-expert reasoning. To evaluate model capabilities, we present a dual categorization framework to jointly analyze performance across seven construction-engineering and four MLLM capability dimensions -- the first to explicitly map engineering workflows to AI reasoning competencies. Evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between model and expert performance, particularly at higher reasoning depths. This benchmark lays a foundation for domain-specialized multimodal reasoning to allow for advancement on integration of AI-driven understanding and real-world engineering workflows.
tldr: DrawingVQA 是首个面向建筑施工图纸的多模态大语言模型评估基准，包含 33 张真实施工图纸和 92 组专家问答对，覆盖感知理解、语境解释和领域专家推理三个深度层次，评估发现当前最先进模型与人类专家之间存在显著差距。

title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks
author: [[Tushar Lone, Neha Karanjkar]]
description: arXiv:2607.09745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). A key motivation behind SupplyNetPy's development is programmatic generation and simulation of complex models, enabling design-space exploration, what-if analysis, training data generation, and supply chain digital twins.
tldr: SupplyNetPy 是一个开源的 Python 库，用于对任意多级结构的供应链网络进行高保真建模与离散事件仿真，支持多种补货策略、易逝品库存和节点中断等场景。

paper_metadata.title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks

research_problem.core_question: 如何构建一个灵活、可扩展、开源的 Python 仿真框架，以支持任意多级结构的供应链网络建模与模拟？
research_problem.motivation: 供应链网络仿真对于设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成和供应链数字孪生等关键应用至关重要。然而，现有的供应链仿真工具多为商业软件（如 AnyLogic、Simio），价格昂贵、扩展性受限，且缺乏对任意多级网络拓扑的原生支持。学术界缺乏一个开源、文档完善、基于 Python 的灵活仿真库，使得研究人员和 practitioners 难以快速原型化复杂的供应链模型并进行大规模实验。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了缺少开源、可扩展、支持任意多级供应链网络拓扑的高保真 Python 仿真库这一空白，为供应链研究社区提供了可编程、可继承的仿真基础设施。

methodology.approach_summary: SupplyNetPy 将供应链网络建模为带有节点和边属性的有向图，采用离散事件仿真引擎驱动仿真时钟推进。库的核心设计围绕可扩展性展开：用户可通过继承机制自定义节点行为（如不同补货策略）、边属性（如随机提前期）和全局策略（如需求生成）。支持多种补货策略（如(s,S)、(R,Q)等）、易逝品库存建模、节点中断事件以及随机需求与提前期。仿真全程记录详细日志，并自动聚合节点级和网络级的性能报告（如服务水平、缺货率、库存周转等）。所有组件通过 Python 类继承实现扩展，用户只需通过字典或 YAML 描述网络结构即可启动仿真。
key_innovations: 支持任意多级供应链网络拓扑（无环图，不限于串行或装配系统），通过图论方法统一建模不同结构
全组件可扩展架构：所有仿真组件（节点、策略、需求生成器、中断模型）均支持通过 Python 继承机制进行自定义
可编程模型生成能力：支持通过脚本程序化生成复杂供应链模型，实现大规模设计空间探索和训练数据自动生成
集成了易逝品库存、节点中断和随机性建模等实际场景关键特性，提升仿真的真实度与工业适用性
inspiration_sources: 离散事件仿真范式（如 SimPy、Arena 等仿真引擎的核心理念）
图论及其在网络流建模中的应用
商业供应链仿真工具（AnyLogic、Simio）的设计经验
运筹学与库存理论中的经典补货策略与库存管理模型

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 对 SupplyNetPy 进行了三方面的验证：(1) 与解析基准模型的对比验证，确保库存仿真输出与理论值一致；(2) 与商业仿真工具的输出对比，验证跨工具的一致性；(3) 基于已发表论文中的案例重构进行复现验证。验证涵盖了基本库存模型、多级供应链和易逝品等多种场景。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 作为开源工具，提供与商业工具一致的高保真仿真能力，同时具备更高的灵活性和可扩展性；支持程序化模型生成，填补了现有开源供应链仿真库在任意多级网络结构支持上的空白。

stated_limitations: 论文自身未明确列出局限性（从摘要和标题判断为工具介绍类论文，通常不在摘要层面讨论局限）
reviewer_concerns: 与已有开源仿真工具（如 SimPy、Salabim）的本质区别和增量贡献不足，核心仿真机制是成熟技术的重新封装
大规模网络下的仿真性能（节点数增加时的计算开销）缺乏定量评估
案例验证规模有限，缺少与多个开源替代品的系统性对比
缺少对仿真结果统计有效性（如 warm-up period、replication 数量）的讨论
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: SupplyNetPy 专注于供应链与库存网络领域，领域特异性较强，但其基于图的建模框架在理论上可扩展至其他网络流仿真场景（如物流网络、生产调度）。泛化到非供应链领域需要用户自行扩展组件，缺乏开箱即用的通用仿真能力。

industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: 作为开源 Python 库，SupplyNetPy 消除了商业仿真软件的高昂许可费用（如 AnyLogic 单用户授权数千美元/年），降低了供应链仿真的使用门槛。基于 Python 生态（pandas 数据处理、matplotlib 可视化、PyTorch 集成）可以零成本衔接数据分析和机器学习管线。对于已有 Python 技术栈的企业，集成成本极低；但对于非技术用户，需要具备基本的编程能力才能充分利用其可扩展性。长期来看，开源模式有利于社区贡献和定制化开发，成本效益显著优于商业替代方案。

title: Improving Molecular Property Prediction in Small Language Models Using Graph-based Tools
author: [[Konstantinos Bougiatiotis, Dimitrios Kelesis, Georgios Paliouras]]
description: arXiv:2607.13115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) have shown promise for zero-shot molecular property prediction from SMILES strings, yet they often suffer from structural blindness because sequence representations under-specify key graph-topological cues. We propose a modular Context-Augmented Prompting framework that enables agentic tool use at inference time: a trained GNN expert model provides a predictive hint with confidence, and a GNN extracts an instance-specific explanatory subgraph (e.g., a subgraph SMILES and an accompanying explanatory paragraph). We evaluate three commonly used SLMs on MUTAG and Tox21 under five prompting configurations ranging from SMILES-only to using all available tools at hand. Across two datasets, enriching prompts with graph-derived context yields substantial accuracy gains, often exceeding 25% relative improvement and up to 74% on Tox21. We further validate the functional relevance of the extracted motifs via a necessity-based edge-drop intervention. Despite the observed gains, a persistent gap remains to specialized GNN models, highlighting both the value and limits of text-conditioned reasoning for molecular structure.
tldr: 一篇 arXiv 论文提出 Context-Augmented Prompting 框架，在推理时让小型语言模型调用图神经网络专家工具来增强分子性质预测能力，在 Tox21 和 MUTAG 数据集上实现最高 74% 的准确率提升。
objective_summary: 该论文针对小型语言模型从 SMILES 字符串进行零样本分子性质预测时存在结构盲点的问题，提出了一种模块化的 Context-Augmented Prompting 框架。该框架在推理时通过智能体工具调用机制，让训练好的 GNN 专家模型提供含置信度的预测提示，并提取实例级别的解释性子图（子图 SMILES 及说明文字）。研究者在 MUTAG 和 Tox21 两个数据集上，用五种提示配置评估了三款常见小型语言模型。实验结果显示，引入图结构上下文后准确率相对提升超过 25%，在 Tox21 上最高达 74%；边缘剔除干预实验验证了提取基序的功能相关性。但模型与专用 GNN 模型之间仍存在持续差距。
key_logic_flow: 小型语言模型在基于 SMILES 序列进行分子性质零样本预测时，因序列表示无法充分表达图拓扑结构线索而产生结构盲点。
论文提出 Context-Augmented Prompting 框架，在推理时让 SLM 调用 GNN 专家模型获取带置信度的预测提示和解释性子图信息。
在 MUTAG 和 Tox21 数据集上，使用五种提示配置评估了三款 SLM，引入图结构上下文后准确率相对提升超过 25%，Tox21 上最高达 74%。
通过必要性边缘剔除干预实验验证了 GNN 提取的分子基序具有功能相关性。
即使有显著提升，该方法的性能仍低于专用 GNN 模型，说明文本条件推理在分子结构理解上既有价值也有局限。

title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
author: [[Zhe Ren, Yimeng Chen, Dandan Guo, Guowei Rong, Tonghui Li, R. B. Xiong, Qingfeng Lan, Wenyi Wang, Li Nanbo, Yibo Yang, Mingchen Zhuge, J\"urgen Schmidhuber]]
description: arXiv:2607.13104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-improving autonomous agents are moving from research prototypes to deployed systems. The primary goal is controllable evolution, or adaptation, from experience with minimal or even no human input. This survey frames modern self-improving agents as adaptive systems that convert experience into accumulated capability gains. We offer a system-level framework that represents a modern agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and control logic. Within this framework, self-improvement is formalized as a self-induced update operator that obtains and commits updates to model parameters or scaffold components. We organize prior work by update target and by the signals that drive change, then review applications and discuss evaluation, before closing with open problems and future directions. For convenience, we track technical updates on https://github.com/selfimproving-agent/awesome-Self-Improving-Agents.
tldr: 该综述论文将现代自改进智能体系统定义为自适应系统，通过基础模型与操作框架（提示、记忆、工具、控制逻辑）的耦合配置，实现从经验中积累能力的可控演化，并形式化地提出自改进作为自诱导更新算子。
objective_summary: 该论文是一篇发表于 arXiv（cs.AI）的综述研究，系统梳理了自改进自主智能体领域的研究进展。论文提出了一个系统级框架，将自改进智能体表示为基础模型与操作框架的耦合配置，并将自改进形式化为自诱导更新算子——该算子获取并提交对模型参数或框架组件的更新。论文按更新目标和驱动信号对已有工作进行归类，并回顾了应用场景和评估方法，最后讨论了开放问题和未来方向。
key_logic_flow: 该论文将现代自改进智能体定义为自适应系统，其核心目标是在最小化甚至无需人工输入的情况下，从经验中实现可控演化，即持续积累能力增益。
论文提出了一个系统级框架，将智能体表示为基础模型与操作框架（包含提示、记忆、工具、控制逻辑等组件）的耦合配置。
在该框架下，自改进被形式化为一个自诱导更新算子，该算子获取并提交对模型参数或框架组件的更新，从而完成自我改进。
论文按更新目标（模型参数 vs. 框架组件）和驱动信号两个维度对现有工作进行分类整理。
论文回顾了自改进智能体在应用层面的实现案例和评估方法，并指出了当前领域的开放问题与未来研究方向。

title: GraphDx: A Cost-Aware Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Agent Framework for Sequential Diagnosis
author: [[Shaoting Tan, Ning Liu, Yuntao Du, Shuyue Wei, Wu Shuai, Qian Li, Yanyu Xu, Wei Zhang, Lizhen Cui, Haitao Yuan]]
description: arXiv:2607.15280v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential diagnosis requires balancing diagnostic accuracy against resource costs through iterative information gathering. Existing Large Language Model (LLM) approaches exhibit a critical knowledge-reasoning gap: despite encoding extensive medical knowledge, they struggle to reason systematically under cost constraints, often resorting to excessive testing. We propose GraphDx, a knowledge-enhanced framework with two core innovations. First, we design an automated pipeline that leverages LLMs to construct Medical Diagnosis Knowledge Graphs (MDKGs) with quantized typicality, action-centric topology, and dual-objective attributes for both diagnostic relevance and cost-sensitivity. Second, we introduce three collaborative agents (Perception, Reasoning, and Decision) where the Perception and Decision Agents handle language understanding and generation, while the Reasoning Agent performs deterministic evidence scoring and cost-aware planning on the MDKG. Experiments on MedQA and MIMIC-IV across three LLM backbones (DeepSeek-V3, Kimi-k2, Llama-3.3) show that GraphDx improves diagnostic success rates from 50--68% to 79--93% while reducing test costs by 20--54%, providing a robust, economical, and interpretable solution for automated clinical diagnosis.
tldr: GraphDx 提出一种成本感知的知识增强多智能体诊断框架，通过 LLM 自动构建医学诊断知识图谱（MDKG），并设计感知、推理、决策三个协作智能体，在 MedQA 和 MIMIC-IV 上将诊断成功率从 50-68% 提升至 79-93%，同时降低测试成本 20-54%。
objective_summary: 该论文提出 GraphDx 框架，用于解决序贯诊断中诊断准确性与资源成本的平衡问题。框架的核心创新包括：利用 LLM 自动构建带量化典型性、动作中心拓扑和双重目标属性的医学诊断知识图谱（MDKG），以及设计感知、推理、决策三个协作智能体，其中推理智能体在 MDKG 上进行确定性证据评分和成本感知规划。在 MedQA 和 MIMIC-IV 数据集上，基于 DeepSeek-V3、Kimi-k2、Llama-3.3 三种大模型的实验显示，GraphDx 将诊断成功率从基线方法的 50-68% 提升至 79-93%，同时将测试成本降低 20-54%。
key_logic_flow: GraphDx 框架解决序贯诊断中准确性与资源成本的平衡问题，通过自动化管道利用 LLM 构建医学诊断知识图谱（MDKG），该图谱具有量化典型性、动作中心拓扑和双重目标属性（诊断相关性与成本敏感性）。
框架设计了三个协作智能体：感知智能体负责语言理解，推理智能体在 MDKG 上进行确定性证据评分和成本感知规划，决策智能体负责语言生成。
在 MedQA 和 MIMIC-IV 两个数据集上，使用 DeepSeek-V3、Kimi-k2、Llama-3.3 三种大模型作为基座进行实验验证。
实验结果显示 GraphDx 将诊断成功率从基线方法的 50-68% 提升至 79-93%，同时将测试成本降低 20-54%，提供了一种稳健、经济且可解释的自动化临床诊断解决方案。

title: SeerGuard: A Safety Framework for Mobile GUI Agents via World Model Prediction
author: [[Xue Yu, Bo Yuan, Pengshuai Yang, Kailin Zhao, Hong Hu, Junlan Feng]]
description: arXiv:2607.15550v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in automating complex tasks, yet they introduce critical safety risks where a single erroneous action can lead to irreversible consequences. Existing safety mechanisms are primarily reactive, lacking the ability to assess risks before execution. In this paper, we introduce SeerGuard, a consequence-aware safety framework designed to mitigate these risks through pre-execution instruction-level screening and action-level risk assessment. Specifically, the action-level assessment analyzes agent-proposed actions within current GUI states, anticipating likely outcomes to identify risks before they are executed. To enable these capabilities, we construct a unified safety-augmented world model (SAWM) via multi-task learning, integrating semantic next-state prediction with safety risk assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SeerGuard generalizes effectively across diverse mobile GUI agents. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, it increases the safety-utility score from $0.191$ to $0.596$ at $\omega=0.8$ and reduces the risk-cost score from $0.347$ to $0.130$ at $\alpha=0.8$. Further analyses on our SAWM validate the effectiveness of the instruction-level screening, alongside the capability of action risk assessment and next-state prediction.
tldr: SeerGuard 是一个面向移动 GUI 智能体的后果感知安全框架，通过执行前指令筛选和动作级风险评估来预防危险操作。在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，它将安全效用评分从 0.191 提升至 0.596。
objective_summary: 该论文提出了 SeerGuard，一个针对移动图形用户界面（GUI）智能体的安全框架。SeerGuard 通过执行前指令级筛选和动作级风险评估来识别潜在风险。框架采用多任务学习构建统一的安全增强世界模型（SAWM），将语义化下一状态预测与安全风险评估相结合。在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上的实验显示，安全效用评分从 0.191 提升至 0.596（ω=0.8），风险成本评分从 0.347 降至 0.130（α=0.8）。
key_logic_flow: SeerGuard 是一个针对移动 GUI 智能体的后果感知安全框架，通过执行前指令筛选和动作级风险评估来降低操作风险。
动作级评估在当前 GUI 状态下分析智能体提出的操作，预测可能的结果以在执行前识别潜在危险。
该框架通过多任务学习构建统一的安全增强世界模型（SAWM），将语义化下一状态预测与安全风险评估融合在同一模型中。
在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，SeerGuard 将安全效用评分从 0.191 提升至 0.596（ω=0.8），并将风险成本评分从 0.347 降至 0.130（α=0.8）。
实验表明 SeerGuard 能够有效泛化到多种不同的移动 GUI 智能体，消融分析验证了指令级筛选和动作风险评估各自的有效性。

title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for LEED compliance: Document-Centric Benchmarking, Deterministic Numeric Checking, and When Multimodal Hurts
author: [[Aritro De (The University of Texas at Austin), Juliana Felkner (The University of Texas at Austin)]]
description: arXiv:2607.15647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LEED v4.1 BD+C certification remains a document-intensive process that requires reviewers to read hundreds of pages of project evidence and apply credit-specific threshold logic by hand. This paper investigates whether small, locally deployed language models can perform meaningful screening of LEED documentation and how deterministic symbolic components should share that work. A neuro-symbolic pipeline is introduced that aligns project PDFs to LEED credit sections, retrieves evidence with credit-aware keyword signatures, verifies compliance with a locally hosted 4-billion-parameter language model, and applies a LEED-specific numeric checker to quantitative thresholds. Experiments on four university buildings (484 PDFs, 153 credit-level decisions) show that a 4-billion-parameter model (gemma3:4b) is the strongest text-only core verifier, achieving 67.3% accuracy and outperforming a larger 8-billion-parameter model (llama3.1:8b) in this task. The deterministic numeric checker corrects arithmetic errors on key quantitative credits, moving EA-p2 from 50% to 100% accuracy and improving several other credits when required values are reliably extracted. At the same time, the full neuro-symbolic configuration achieves 61.6% overall accuracy, trailing the best text-only baseline due to extraction failures and conservative behavior on qualitative categories. Systematic ablations show that adding low-resolution drawing images (150-300 dpi) consistently reduces accuracy, and that prompt effectiveness depends on the building's ground-truth PASS rate: rubric prompts perform best on documentation-rich projects, while chain-of-thought prompts perform best on documentation-lean projects. Within the specific scope of LEED v4.1 BD+C compliance verification over raw project documentation, this pipeline and its baselines provide an initial reproducible reference point for both accuracy and failure modes.
tldr: 一篇研究论文提出神经符号学管道用于LEED v4.1 BD+C认证合规检查，基于484份PDF和153个信用级别决策的实验表明，4B参数的gemma3:4b模型在纯文本验证中达67.3%准确率，优于8B参数的llama3.1:8b，确定性数值检查器将EA-p2信用从50%提升至100%准确率，而添加低分辨率图纸图片反而降低准确率。
objective_summary: 该论文针对LEED v4.1 BD+C认证流程中文档密集型人工审核效率低的问题，设计了一套神经符号学管道，将项目PDF对齐到LEED信用章节、通过信用感知关键词签名检索证据、使用本地部署的4B参数语言模型进行合规验证，并应用确定性数值检查器处理定量阈值。在四栋大学建筑共484份PDF和153个信用级别决策上的实验表明，gemma3:4b作为纯文本核心验证器达到67.3%准确率，超越更大规模的llama3.1:8b模型。确定性数值检查器纠正了关键定量信用的算术错误，将EA-p2准确率从50%提升至100%。完整的神经符号学配置总体准确率为61.6%，低于最佳纯文本基线，原因在于提取失败和在定性类别上的保守行为。系统性消融实验显示添加150-300dpi低分辨率图纸图片持续降低准确率，且Rubric提示在文档丰富的项目上表现最佳，Chain-of-Thought提示在文档稀少的项目上表现最佳。
key_logic_flow: 论文针对LEED v4.1 BD+C认证文档密集型人工审核流程，提出了一套神经符号学管道来自动化合规检查。
该管道包含四个步骤：将项目PDF对齐到LEED信用章节、使用信用感知关键词签名检索证据、通过本地部署的4B参数语言模型验证合规性、以及应用确定性数值检查器处理定量阈值。
