title: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent
author: [[Zayx Shawn]]
description: arXiv:2607.09678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When LLM agents hand off information to one another, does the message format matter? Two literatures disagree: format-optimization work reports that structured messages cut cost without hurting accuracy, while format-restriction work finds that imposing structure degrades generation -- and neither measures what happens when a message traverses multiple hops, where copy fidelity, not one-shot generation, dominates. We introduce a controlled relay testbed: briefs of twelve programmatically generated atomic facts are re-encoded hop-by-hop in five formats (free NL, precision-instructed NL, JSON, triples, key-value) over six hops, scored by a fixed strong grader against programmatic ground truth, across two relay-capability tiers, a cognitive-load condition, and a paired-fork error injection. We find that message-format effects are tier-dependent. (i) Under faithful-relay instructions a strong relay is nearly lossless -- the documented "telephone-game" collapse does not occur -- and adding per-hop cognitive load leaves format-level fidelity unchanged (within +/-1.8 points) while raising generation cost by 24-53%. (ii) Under a weak (1.5B) relay the across-format spread of six-hop recall grows by a factor of 8.7 (from 2.3 to 20.5 points), driven by two opposing mechanisms -- an encoding toll paid by the rigid formats and drift resistance specific to the fixed-key JSON schema -- that flip the format ranking in transit. (iii) In a paired-fork injection, an injected wrong value, once present, persists to the final hop in 83-100% of chains in every format, closely matching each format's retention of the true value, with no detectable collateral damage to neighboring facts. Structure buys a faithful, error-localizing channel -- not an error-correcting code -- and format choice should follow the weakest relay in the pipeline.
tldr: 多跳Agent中继消息格式效果取决于能力层级，结构化格式是忠实通道而非纠错码
objective_summary: 研究人员通过受控实验发现，多跳LLM Agent中继中消息格式效果取决于中继能力层级：强中继近乎无损传递信息，弱中继下跨格式召回率差距扩大8.7倍；错误一旦注入在83-100%的链条中持续传递且不造成附带损害。
key_logic_flow: 研究构建了受控中继测试平台，用5种消息格式（自由自然语言、精确指令自然语言、JSON、三元组、键值对）进行6跳信息传递实验，由固定强评分器对照程序化真值评分。
在忠实中继指令下，强中继模型近乎无损传递信息（跨格式差异仅2.3个百分点），未出现传统"电话游戏"式信息坍塌，增加认知负载后格式级保真度变化在±1.8点以内。
弱中继（1.5B）模型下6跳召回率跨格式差距扩大至20.5个百分点，刚性格式的编码代价与固定键JSON的抗漂移机制相互对立，导致格式排名在传输过程中翻转。
错误注入实验中，注入的错误值一旦出现就在83-100%的链条中持续传递到最终跳，与真值保留率高度匹配，且不对相邻事实造成附带损害。
结构化格式提供了一个忠实、错误定位的通道而非纠错码，格式选择应跟随管道中最弱的中继环节。

paper_metadata.title: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent

research_problem.core_question: 在多跳LLM Agent接力传话中，消息格式（自由文本 vs 结构化格式）对信息保真度的影响是什么？该影响是否依赖于接力模型的能力层级？
research_problem.motivation: 多Agent系统中，信息需要在不同LLM Agent之间逐跳传递（类似传话游戏）。现有研究存在矛盾结论：格式优化方向的工作认为结构化消息（JSON/三元组）可降低成本而不损失准确性；格式约束方向的工作发现结构化会损害生成质量。但两者都未测量消息经过多跳传输后的拷贝保真度（copy fidelity）。随着多Agent编排系统在实际应用中日益普及，理解消息格式在多跳接力中如何影响信息保真度对系统设计至关重要。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了多跳Agent接力场景中消息格式对信息保真度影响的系统性实证空白，特别是揭示了格式效应依赖于接力模型能力层级这一关键发现，调和了此前文献中相互矛盾的结论。

methodology.approach_summary: 论文设计了一个受控的接力测试平台：将12条程序化生成的原子事实以5种格式（自由自然语言、精确指令自然语言、JSON、三元组、键值对）逐跳重新编码，跨越6跳，由固定强评估器根据程序化真实值评分。实验在两个接力能力层级（强模型 vs 1.5B弱模型）、认知负载条件和配对分支错误注入场景下进行对比。通过精确测量每跳的信息召回率和格式转换代价，系统性地揭示了格式选择与模型能力之间的交互效应。
key_innovations: 提出多跳Agent接力保真度的受控测试实验框架，将原子事实逐跳追踪而非仅测单次生成质量，填补了该领域的系统评估空白
发现格式效应具有层级依赖性（tier-dependent）：强接力下几乎无损（无电话游戏崩塌），而弱接力下格式间召回率差距扩大8.7倍
揭示两种相反的机制——刚性格式的编码代价（encoding toll）与固定键JSON范式的漂移抵抗（drift resistance），两者在传输过程中翻转格式排名
通过配对分支错误注入实验证实结构格式提供的是保真、错误定位的信道（error-localizing channel），而不是纠错码（error-correcting code），这一结论具有实践指导意义

LLM格式优化（format-optimization）与格式约束（format-restriction）两派文献的矛盾观点

title: Behavioral Controllability of Agentic Models for Information Extraction: From Fixed Workflows to Reflective Agents
author: [[Lujia Zhang, Xingzhou Chen, Hongwei Feng]]
description: arXiv:2607.15715v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for complex information-extraction tasks, yet it remains unclear whether agentic components such as reflection and memory lead to observable and controllable improvements over fixed LLM workflows. We study this question through conference-paper dataset extraction, where a system must identify datasets mentioned in scholarly PDFs and produce structured records. We compare a fixed workflow baseline with reflective agent variants and specify an optimized agent condition (S2) that extends the same task with richer PDF tools and dynamic tool selection. Our evaluation emphasizes process-level behavior--including tool execution, retries, reflection, memory use, runtime, and failure recovery--while treating extraction coverage and field completeness as secondary outcome measures. The paper characterizes when agentic mechanisms change system behavior, whether these changes improve task completion, and how the observed failure modes motivate an optimized agent design under the same evaluation harness.
tldr: 该论文通过学术会议论文数据集抽取任务，对比了固定工作流基线、反思代理变体和优化代理条件（S2）在信息抽取中的表现，重点评估工具执行、反思和记忆等过程级行为对任务完成的提升效果。
objective_summary: 该论文在学术会议论文数据集抽取场景中，研究了反思和记忆等代理组件相比固定LLM工作流能否带来可观察且可控的改进。论文设计了固定工作流基线、反思代理变体和优化代理条件（S2）三种对比方案，评估聚焦于工具执行、重试、反思、记忆使用、运行时间和失败恢复等过程级行为指标。实验将抽取覆盖率和字段完整性作为次要结果指标，揭示了代理机制改变系统行为的条件以及这些变化对任务完成度的影响。
key_logic_flow: 论文研究了在信息抽取场景中，包含反思和记忆功能的代理组件是否能带来优于固定LLM工作流的可观察和可控改进。

论文设计了三种对比方案：固定工作流基线、反思代理变体以及优化的代理条件S2（配备更丰富的PDF工具和动态工具选择能力）。
评估侧重工具执行、重试、反思、记忆使用、运行时间和失败恢复等过程级行为指标，抽取覆盖率和字段完整性作为次要结果指标。
论文分析了代理机制改变系统行为的条件、这些变化对任务完成度的提升效果，以及观察到的失败模式如何推动优化代理设计。

title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
author: [[Chih-Hsuan Yang, Jingyan Jiang, Vikram Vasudevan, Cheng-Hau Yang, Huihuo Zheng, Le Chen, Eliu A. Huerta, Venkatram Vishwanath, Ian T. Foster, Rajeev Thakur]]
description: arXiv:2607.15388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many math- and science-oriented agent systems use hierarchical designs with specialized reviewer roles, assuming that a dedicated review stage should help turn wrong candidates into correct ones. We test this assumption on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. Collaboration adds little on the easiest tiers, but from tier 4 onward the gains open sharply; in this harder regime, broadcast-style peer discussion reaches higher final accuracy than a planner-executor-reviewer pipeline (PER). We ask whether this gap is explained by reviewer quality or by whether critique changes the next answer the protocol carries forward. It is not explained by reviewer precision alone: PER's reviewer is more precise than broadcast's (0.861 vs. 0.644), yet evaluator-verified useful critique is much less likely to change the next candidate and produces lower reviewer-guided repair. These results show that reviewer detection quality and critique uptake are empirically separable. Within matched PER interventions, forcing explicit acknowledgment lowers final accuracy, while embedding reviewer guidance directly in the solver's working context partially improves follow-through without closing the gap. Overall, reviewer-centric evaluation can overstate system quality: a protocol may spot errors well yet still fail to solve more problems if it does not act on those critiques.
tldr: 一篇 arXiv 论文通过 4,181 道 Omni-MATH 题目的实验发现，在多智能体数学推理系统中，审稿者的精确度并不保证其批评意见能被采纳。广播式同行讨论的最终准确率高于规划者-执行者-审稿者流水线，尽管后者的审稿者更精确（0.861 vs 0.644），问题在于批评意见的采纳率而非审稿质量。
objective_summary: 该论文在 4,181 道 Omni-MATH 题目上，使用 gpt-oss-120b 模型作为参与者，对比了广播式同行讨论与规划者-执行者-审稿者流水线两种多智能体协作方式的表现。实验发现，在较难的题目上广播式讨论的最终准确率显著高于 PER 流水线。PER 的审稿者精确率为 0.861，高于广播式的 0.644，但其有价值的批评意见更难改变下一轮的候选答案，导致修复效率更低。在 PER 干预实验中，强制显式确认降低了最终准确率，而将审稿指导直接嵌入解题者的工作上下文能部分改善采纳率但仍无法弥合差距。

title: AI-Native Insurance for Agentic AI: Pricing, Underwriting, and End-to-End Automation
author: [[Quanyan Zhu]]
description: arXiv:2607.13230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic AI introduces new insurance challenges because autonomous AI systems can make decisions, invoke tools, modify external environments, and interact with third-party services. This paper develops an AI-native mathematical framework for underwriting, pricing, and contract design for agentic AI deployments. A deployment is represented by a risk state that captures autonomy level, operational authority, permission exposure, governance maturity, and dependency concentration. The framework maps the risk state to event probabilities, loss severities, governance costs, premiums, deductibles, coverage allocation, and policy covenants, and formulates an optimization problem for insurance contract design under participation, profitability, and incentive compatibility constraints. The paper establishes structural properties of insurability, including characterization of an insurability region, monotone deterioration of feasibility with increasing exposure, and governance certification thresholds. Insurance is further interpreted as both an operational cost and a regulatory mechanism for AI deployment. A healthcare case study illustrates contract optimization, sensitivity analysis, and automated claims processing for agentic AI systems.

title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
author: [[Ruhan Wang, Yucheng Shi, Zongxia Li, Zhongzhi Li, Yue Yu, Junyao Yang, Kishan Panaganti, Haitao Mi, Dongruo Zhou,  Leoweiliang]]
description: arXiv:2607.13285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The capability of a modern AI agent depends not only on its foundation model but also on its harness, which constructs prompts, manages state, invokes tools, and coordinates execution. As models, APIs, environments, and requirements evolve, the harness must be continually modified. Before such a change can be made, a developer or coding agent must identify all code locations that implement the target behavior. This is difficult because production harnesses are large, tightly coupled, and behaviorally distributed, while modification requests describe what the system should do and repositories are organized by files and modules. Code search, repository indexing, and long-context processing ease inspection, but still leave this behavior-to-code mapping to be recovered by hand. Behavior localization is therefore a central bottleneck in harness evolution. We introduce the Harness Handbook, a behavior-centric representation synthesized automatically from a harness codebase via static analysis and LLM-assisted structuring, linking each behavior to its corresponding source. We also introduce Behavior-Guided Progressive Disclosure (BGPD), which guides agents from high-level behaviors to relevant implementation details and verifies candidate locations against the current source. On diverse modification requests from two open-source harnesses, Handbook-Assisted planning improves behavior localization and edit-plan quality while using fewer planner tokens, with the largest gains on scattered sites, rarely executed paths, and cross-module interactions. Evolving complex agentic systems thus depends not only on generating edits, but also on determining where those edits should be made.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为 Harness Handbook 的行为中心化表征方法，通过静态分析和 LLM 辅助结构自动从智能体框架代码库中合成，将每个行为链接到对应源代码，以解决行为定位这一框架演化的核心瓶颈问题。
objective_summary: 论文指出 AI 智能体的能力不仅取决于基础模型，还取决于其框架（harness），后者负责构建提示词、管理状态、调用工具和协调执行。随着模型、API、环境和需求的演化，框架需要不断修改，但开发者或编码智能体必须首先定位实现目标行为的所有代码位置，这在大型、紧耦合的生产框架中极为困难。作者提出 Harness Handbook，一种通过静态分析和 LLM 辅助结构自动合成行为中心化表征的方法，并引入行为引导渐进披露（BGPD）方法，引导智能体从高层行为逐步深入到相关实现细节。在两个开源框架的多样化修改请求上，基于 Handbook 的规划在行为定位和编辑计划质量上均有提升，同时使用更少的 planner token。

title: Beyond a Joke: Multi-Angle Reasoning for Detecting and Explaining Harmful Humor in Memes
author: [[Shanhong Liu, Pai Chet Ng, De Wen Soh, Malika Meghjani, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis]]
description: arXiv:2607.15442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Internet memes intertwine visual cues, textual content, and cultural context, making them particularly challenging to interpret in scenarios where humor, sarcasm, and harmful intent coexist. These complexities highlight the need for explainable meme understanding systems that can provide reliable and structured reasoning to support both accurate classification and human interpretability. However, existing multimodal classifiers either overlook these interdependencies or provide only limited interpretability. In this paper, we introduce MAR-12, a novel framework that leverages Vision Language Models (VLMs) for meme detection and understanding in settings where humorous and hateful elements may coexist. The framework first interprets each meme through twelve structured perspectives derived from humor and hate theories. It then applies a role-aware soft-gated attention mechanism to learn how much each perspective should contribute, followed by a prototype-based classifier for the final prediction. Finally, explanations are synthesized using both perspective-specific reasoning and learned attention weights, ensuring transparent and context-grounded justifications. We evaluate MAR-12 on the PrideMM and Memotion datasets, where it achieves up to 80.3% accuracy for humor detection and 75.9% accuracy for hate detection, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches. Furthermore, both human and GPT-4-based evaluations confirm that MAR-12 produces coherent and persuasive explanations, particularly for memes in which humorous and harmful cues co-occur.
tldr: 研究团队提出 MAR-12 框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从12个结构化视角分析网络迷因中的有害幽默，在 PrideMM 和 Memotion 数据集上幽默检测准确率达 80.3%，仇恨检测达 75.9%，并生成可解释的推理依据。
objective_summary: 该论文提出了 MAR-12 框架，用于检测和理解同时包含幽默与仇恨元素的网络迷因。框架首先基于幽默与仇恨理论从12个结构化视角解析迷因，然后通过角色感知的软门控注意力机制学习每个视角的贡献权重，再使用基于原型分类器做出最终预测，最后综合各视角推理与注意力权重生成解释。在 PrideMM 和 Memotion 数据集上，MAR-12 的幽默检测准确率达到 80.3%，仇恨检测准确率达到 75.9%，超越现有最优方法。人类评估和 GPT-4 评估均确认 MAR-12 能生成连贯且有说服力的解释。

在 PrideMM 和 Memotion 数据集上，MAR-12 的幽默检测准确率为 80.3%，仇恨检测准确率为 75.9%，均超过现有最优方法。
人类评估和 GPT-4 评估均证实 MAR-12 生成的解释连贯且具有说服力，尤其对幽默与有害线索共存的迷因效果更佳。

title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning with Tool-Augmented Evidence for Urban Region Profiling
author: [[Xixuan Hao, Yutian Jiang, Jiabo Liu, Yihang Yang, Guangyin Jin, Song Gao, Yuxuan Liang]]
description: arXiv:2607.13558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban region profiling constitutes a core problem in urban computing, supporting applications such as population estimation, economic assessment, and environmental monitoring. Existing methods typically formulate this task as multimodal representation learning, fusing heterogeneous urban data, e.g., satellite imagery, points of interest, textual descriptions, and 3D building information, into latent embeddings for prediction. However, these approaches are largely correlation-driven, assume cross-modal consistency, and rely on static pipelines, which limit their robustness in heterogeneous or unseen urban regions. We propose UrbanAgent, an agentic framework that reframes urban region profiling as a reasoning-driven inference problem. UrbanAgent instantiates an independent agent for each data modality and performs structured multi-agent collaborative reasoning to explicitly address cross-modal inconsistencies rather than absorbing them into a single representation. In addition, UrbanAgent extends indicator prediction as a closed-loop process of active evidence acquisition and iterative reasoning, enabling agents to verify uncertain inferences through tool-augmented retrieval of external knowledge optimized via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on global urban datasets for Carbon emissions, GDP, and Population estimation show that UrbanAgent consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average improvement of 8.1% in R2, and exhibiting strong generalization performance in unseen-city settings.
tldr: arXiv 上发表了一篇题为 UrbanAgent 的论文，提出一种多智能体协作推理框架，将城市区域画像从传统的多模态表征学习重构为推理驱动的问题，通过独立智能体处理每种数据模态并协作解决跨模态不一致问题，在全球城市数据集上平均 R² 提升 8.1%。
objective_summary: 该论文提出 UrbanAgent 框架，将城市区域画像问题重构为推理驱动的多智能体协作过程。UrbanAgent 为每种数据模态（如卫星图像、兴趣点、文本描述和3D建筑信息）实例化一个独立智能体，通过结构化多智能体协作推理显式处理跨模态不一致性。该框架还将指标预测扩展为主动证据获取和迭代推理的闭环过程，智能体通过工具增强的外部知识检索（经强化学习优化）来验证不确定的推断。在全球城市数据集上的碳排放、GDP 和人口估算实验中，UrbanAgent 平均 R² 较现有基线提升 8.1%，并在未见城市场景中表现出强泛化能力。

title: EZSMT Version 3, Matured
author: [[Yuliya Lierler]]
description: arXiv:2607.13344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constraint Answer Set Programming (CASP) is a hybrid reasoning paradigm that combines Answer Set Programming (ASP) with Constraint Processing and Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT), enabling powerful declarative encodings of complex combinatorial search problems. This paper presents the design and implementation of EZSMTV3, an extensible SMT-based CASP framework that advances the translational approach to CASP solving. Building upon the foundation of the EZSMT+ system, EZSMTV3 introduces a more expressive input language, supports optimization via weak constraints, and offers foundations for streamlined integration of new constraint types. Rather than implementing custom search procedures, EZSMTV3 leverages state-of-the-art SMT solvers, such as CVC5, YICES, and Z3 to perform reasoning. The paper provides benchmarking results comparing EZSMTV3 with its CASP peers such as CLINGCON, CLINGO[DL], and CLINGO[LP], while showcasing its ability to handle mixed-domain constraints involving both integers and reals. The system provides a robust platform for future extensions and theoretical exploration within the CASP domain.
tldr: EZSMTV3 是一个基于 SMT 求解器的约束回答集编程（CASP）框架，扩展了 EZSMT+ 系统，引入更表达力的输入语言、支持弱约束优化，并简化新约束类型集成，在基准测试中与 CLINGCON、CLINGO[DL]、CLINGO[LP] 等系统进行了对比。
objective_summary: 该论文介绍了 EZSMTV3（第三版 EZSMT）的设计与实现，这是一个基于可满足性模理论（SMT）的约束回答集编程（CASP）框架。EZSMTV3 在 EZSMT+ 的基础上，提供了更具表达力的输入语言、通过弱约束支持优化功能，并为新约束类型的集成提供了简化基础。该系统不实现自定义搜索过程，而是利用 CVC5、YICES 和 Z3 等现有 SMT 求解器进行推理。论文提供了 EZSMTV3 与 CLINGCON、CLINGO[DL] 和 CLINGO[LP] 等同类系统的基准测试结果，展示了其处理涉及整数和实数的混合域约束的能力。

title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time
author: [[Stefano Grassi]]
description: arXiv:2607.09714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems (FCMS) architecture formalizes closed-loop coordination through four abstract operators, two of which - the agent update operator $f_i$ and the environmental update operator $\Psi$ - are left axiomatically undefined in the original framework. To address this, $f_i$ is defined by Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), where agents update locally through a decentralized price mechanism and economic principles, and $\Psi$ is defined by the Coupled Memory Graph Process (CMGP), a non-Markovian framework where the environment is treated as a physical substrate that records and responds to trajectory history coherently without external forcing. The resulting continuous-time FCMS instantiation achieves Lyapunov global dissipativity governed by the computable threshold $4\beta^2 < 2\eta\mu\gamma^2$. This generalizes both the discrete FCMS stability condition $4\eta\beta^2 < \gamma$ and CMGP's physical bifurcation threshold $\alpha_c = 1/K$, confirming that memory dissipation must outpace feedback gain as a universal organizing principle. Numerical simulation with $N=2$ agents and mean-field validation at $N=10^6$ confirm the stability threshold and the self-reinforcing coordination cascade that emerges when it is violated.
tldr: 该论文提出了连续时间下的反馈耦合记忆系统框架，通过机制智能和耦合记忆图过程分别定义了代理更新与环境更新算子，并建立了李雅普诺夫全局耗散性稳定条件。
objective_summary: 该论文匿名发表于arXiv，针对反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）框架中两个原未定义的操作符进行了具体化定义：使用基于机制智能（MBI）的分散式价格机制定义代理更新算子，使用耦合记忆图过程（CMGP）定义环境更新算子。理论推导表明连续时间FCMS达到李雅普诺夫全局耗散性的阈值条件为4β² < 2ημγ²。数值模拟在N=2代理系统及N=10⁶均场验证中确认了该稳定性阈值，并在阈值被违反时观测到自强化协调级联现象。
key_logic_flow: FCMS架构通过四个抽象算子形式化闭环协调，但代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ在原框架中未被定义。
论文使用基于机制智能的分散式价格机制定义f_i，使代理通过经济原则进行本地更新。
论文使用耦合记忆图过程定义Ψ，将环境视为记录和响应轨迹历史的物理基质，无需外部强制力。
连续时间FCMS实现李雅普诺夫全局耗散性的条件是4β² < 2ημγ²。
该条件统一了离散FCMS稳定性条件4ηβ² < γ和CMGP物理分岔阈值α_c = 1/K，确认记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益是普适组织原则。
N=2的数值模拟和N=10⁶的均场验证确认了稳定性阈值及其被违反时的自强化协调级联现象。

paper_metadata.title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time

research_problem.core_question: 如何形式化定义反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）中原本未指定的代理更新算子和环境更新算子，并建立统一的连续时间稳定性条件？
research_problem.motivation: 原始FCMS框架通过四个抽象算子形式化闭环协调机制，但其中两个核心算子——代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ——被留作公理未定义，导致框架无法具体实例化。同时，离散FCMS稳定性条件和CMGP物理分岔阈值分属不同理论体系，缺乏统一的数学理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，为闭环协调系统提供严格的形式化基础。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了FCMS框架中两个核心算子缺乏具体定义的空白，并将离散FCMS稳定条件与CMGP物理分岔阈值统一为连续时间下的单一稳定性判据，揭示了记忆耗散与反馈增益之间的普适定量关系。

methodology.approach_summary: 本文提出了一种连续时间下的反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）形式化框架。针对原始FCMS框架中未定义的代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ，分别采用两种不同理论进行定义：f_i通过基于机制智能（MBI）的分散价格机制定义，使代理通过经济原则进行局部更新；Ψ通过耦合记忆图过程（CMGP）定义，将环境视为具有记忆的物理基底，以非马尔可夫方式记录和响应系统轨迹历史。在此基础上推导了李雅普诺夫全局耗散性稳定条件4β² < 2ημγ²，统一了离散FCMS稳定性条件4ηβ² < γ和CMGP物理分岔阈值α_c = 1/K。最后通过N=2代理的数值模拟和N=10^6的平均场验证了稳定阈值。
key_innovations: 将MBI的经济学价格机制引入FCMS，为原本公理性的代理更新算子f_i提供了具体定义和动力学机制
将CMGP的非马尔可夫物理基底框架用于定义环境更新算子Ψ，将环境建模为具有轨迹记忆的响应式物理基质
推导出连续时间FCMS的统一稳定性阈值并证明其泛化了离散FCMS和CMGP两个独立框架的稳定性条件，确立了"记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益"作为跨系统的通用组织原则

title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
author: [[Ziwei Ye]]
description: arXiv:2607.13396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: What happens to an LLM agent's tool choice when the reliable tool silently changes within an ongoing session? We borrow set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study how well agents adapt to hidden reliability shifts. Our benchmark mounts tool-skill libraries with redundancies, where many tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. In our evaluation framework, a branched schedule shifts the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs every shift with a no-shift control. We find that agents, by default, settle on a small recurring routine within a few turns of each boundary, with call shares concentrating on a few discrete values after each reliability shift. We score the set-shifting accuracy for each agent trajectory: the joint probability of routing to the target tool group in every post-shift window. We test open-weight LLMs in an open-source agentic harness and find qualitatively distinct failure modes across the same set of routines. We also find that set framing, how the toolset presents the alternatives as competing or complementary, shifts the routing dynamics.
tldr: 研究人员从认知心理学借用set-shifting概念，构建了一套评估LLM代理在工具可靠性静默变化时适应能力的基准测试方法。
objective_summary: 该研究借用认知心理学的set-shifting概念，设计了一个基准测试框架来评估LLM代理面对工具可靠性静默变化时的适应能力。框架构建了具有冗余功能的工具技能库，多个工具可解决同一任务但隐藏可靠性不同。通过分支调度在隐藏边界切换可靠工具组，每个切换配以无切换对照组。实验发现代理默认会在每次边界后几轮内形成固定选择模式，调用集中在少数离散值上。研究在开源代理框架上测试了开源LLM，发现相同工具集对应截然不同的失败模式，且工具集的框架呈现方式（竞争或互补）会影响路由选择动态。
key_logic_flow: 研究人员从认知心理学中借用set-shifting概念，用于研究LLM代理在工具可靠性发生静默变化时的适应能力。
基准测试创建了具有冗余功能的工具技能库，多个工具可以解决同一任务但隐藏的可靠性各不相同。
通过分支调度在隐藏边界切换可靠工具组，每个切换都配有无切换的对照组进行对比评估。
实验发现代理默认会在每次边界后几轮内形成固定的选择模式，工具调用集中在少数离散值上。
研究测试了开源LLM在开源代理框架中的表现，发现相同的工具集对应着截然不同的失败模式。
工具集的框架呈现方式——即各工具被呈现为竞争关系还是互补关系——会影响代理的路由选择动态。

title: SPINE: Bridging the Cyber-Physical Gap with Agentic AI
author: [[Minkyu Ham, Dongho Kim, Chan Lee, Jiayi Wang, Min Jun Kim, Yixi Zhang, Guo Ye, Jihai Zhao, Soyeon Park, Han Liu]]
description: arXiv:2607.13049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models have given robots a sophisticated brain for complex decision-making, yet deploying that intelligence into a physical platform still demands tedious, expert-driven calibration. This deployment gap, the robot's spinal cord, remains a primary bottleneck to scalable Embodied AI. Hence, we propose SPINE (Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise): an agentic framework for systematically debugging and deploying bimanual robots with minimal robotics expertise. SPINE's harness comprises two orchestrated multi-agent workflows: a profile builder that creates robot-specific context, and a debugger that cycles through diagnosis, repair, and validation until teleoperation works. Across seven DOBOT X-Trainer debugging scenarios, a robotics novice using SPINE outperformed human operators using Claude Code with the same reference materials, but without SPINE's structured workflow, improving operationalization success from 75% to 100% and reducing mean time-to-teleoperation from 16 min 45 s to 13 min 47 s. On AgileX PiPER, a distinct ROS/CAN bimanual arm, SPINE resolved all 10 implanted bugs, versus 9 out of 10 for the expert baseline, in nearly the same amount of time. Together, these results show that SPINE can transfer across bimanual platforms, reduce dependence on expert calibration, and move embodied AI closer to scalable real-world deployment.
tldr: SPINE 是一个面向双臂机器人的智能体框架，通过自动化调试和部署流水线实现零专家依赖的机器人操控。实验表明，在 DOBOT X-Trainer 上，新手使用 SPINE 将遥操作成功率从 75% 提升至 100%，平均耗时从 16 分 45 秒降至 13 分 47 秒；在 AgileX PiPER 上，SPINE 修复了全部 10 个植入故障，超越专家基线。
objective_summary: 来自 arXiv 的论文提出了 SPINE（Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise）框架，旨在解决具身智能系统中从基础模型到物理平台的部署鸿沟问题。SPINE 包含两个多智能体工作流：Profile Builder 创建机器人特定上下文，Debugger 循环执行诊断、修复和验证直至遥操作可用。在 DOBOT X-Trainer 双臂机器人上，无机器人专业知识的操作员使用 SPINE 将遥操作成功率从 75% 提升至 100%，平均时间从 16 分 45 秒缩短到 13 分 47 秒。在基于 ROS/CAN 的 AgileX PiPER 平台上，SPINE 修复了全部 10 个植入故障，而专家基线为 9 个，两者耗时几乎相同。
key_logic_flow: SPINE 是一个针对双臂机器人部署调试的多智能体框架，目标是降低对机器人专家校准的依赖。
SPINE 包含两个核心工作流：Profile Builder 负责构建机器人特有的上下文信息，Debugger 循环执行诊断、修复和验证步骤直至遥操作功能正常工作。
在 DOBOT X-Trainer 上的七种调试场景中，使用 SPINE 的机器人新手将遥操作成功率从 75% 提升至 100%，平均耗时从 16 分 45 秒降至 13 分 47 秒。
在基于 ROS/CAN 通信的 AgileX PiPER 双臂机器人上，SPINE 修复了全部 10 个植入故障，优于专家基线的 9 个修复结果，且耗时几乎相同。
实验结果表明 SPINE 具备跨双臂机器人平台的迁移能力，能够有效降低具身智能系统规模化部署的工程门槛。

object_insights.name: SPINE
object_insights.positioning: SPINE（Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise）是一个面向双臂机器人的智能体框架，通过自动化调试和部署流水线解决从基础模型到物理平台的部署鸿沟问题，旨在减少对机器人专家校准的依赖。
object_insights.technical_signal: 提出双多智能体工作流架构：Profile Builder 构建机器人特定上下文信息，Debugger 循环执行诊断-修复-验证直至遥操作可用。在 DOBOT X-Trainer（七种调试场景）和 AgileX PiPER（ROS/CAN 平台）上均验证了有效性，证明具备跨双臂机器人平台迁移能力。
object_insights.adoption_signal: 在 DOBOT X-Trainer 上将机器人新手的遥操作成功率从 75% 提升至 100%，平均耗时从 16 分 45 秒降至 13 分 47 秒；在 AgileX PiPER 上修复全部 10 个植入故障，超越专家基线的 9 个修复结果。
object_insights.ecosystem_relevance: 填补了基础模型智能到物理平台执行之间的关键空白，降低具身智能系统规模化部署的工程门槛，可能推动机器人部署从专家密集型向自动化调试转变。

title: A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles
author: [[Joshua Kofi Asamoah, Blessing Agyei Kyem, Eugene Denteh, Armstrong Aboah]]
description: arXiv:2607.09740v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safe motion planning in advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous vehicles requires an accurate understanding of how the surrounding traffic scene is likely to evolve. However, many existing lane-change prediction methods remain centered on a single target vehicle, while multi-agent forecasting approaches often describe scene evolution only through future positions and provide limited explicit information about the maneuver associated with each vehicle. This study proposes a dynamic scene graph attention framework that predicts the lane-change intention and future trajectory of every relevant vehicle within a local traffic scene. The scene is represented as a time-varying interaction graph in which vehicles are modeled as nodes and their spatial and kinematic relationships are encoded through explicit edge features. Temporal graph-attention message passing captures evolving inter-vehicle dependencies and pre-maneuver cues, while an intention-guided decoder links each predicted maneuver to its corresponding future motion. A scene-level consistency objective further encourages compatible multi-vehicle futures. Experiments on the NGSIM I-80, NGSIM US-101, and highD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines. DSiGAT achieves intention prediction accuracies of 90.12% and 90.97% on NGSIM I-80 and US-101, respectively, and reduces trajectory RMSE by up to 52.94% relative to the strongest baseline. It also produces lower inter-agent collision rates and joint displacement errors, indicating more coherent scene-level predictions. Ablation, sensitivity, robustness, and qualitative analyses further validate the contribution of the proposed components and the effectiveness of the scene-focused formulation.
tldr: 提出DSiGAT动态场景图注意力框架，同时预测多车换道意图和轨迹，准确率达90%以上。
objective_summary: 研究者提出DSiGAT框架，将交通场景建模为时变交互图，通过图注意力消息传递机制同时预测场景内所有车辆的换道意图和未来轨迹。在NGSIM I-80、US-101和highD三个数据集上，意图预测准确率达90.12%-90.97%，轨迹RMSE较最强基线降低最高52.

意图引导解码器将预测的操控行为（如换道意图）与对应的未来运动轨迹关联输出。
场景级一致性目标函数约束多车辆的未来预测在场景层面保持兼容。
在NGSIM I-80、NGSIM US-101和highD数据集上，DSiGAT意图预测准确率达90.12%-90.97%，轨迹RMSE较最强基线降低最高52.94%。

paper_metadata.title: A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles

research_problem.core_question: 如何在一个局部交通场景中同时预测所有相关车辆的车道变更意图和未来轨迹？
research_problem.motivation: 安全运动规划是高级驾驶辅助系统和自动驾驶的核心需求，需要准确理解周围交通场景的演化趋势。然而，现有车道变更预测方法大多聚焦于单一目标车辆，多智能体预测方法则仅输出未来位置而缺乏与每辆车关联的显式机动意图信息。这种信息缺失使得下游规划模块难以理解场景中每辆车"将要做什么"而不仅仅是"要去哪里"。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了现有方法在"场景级多车交互推理"与"显式变道意图预测"之间的空白——既不是单车变道预测，也不是仅输出位置的纯轨迹预测，而是同时为场景中所有相关车辆提供变道意图和对应轨迹的联合预测框架。

methodology.approach_summary: 提出动态场景图注意力框架（DSiGAT）：将局部交通场景建模为时变交互图，车辆作为节点，通过显式边特征编码空间与运动学关系。采用时序图注意力消息传递机制捕获不断演化的车辆间依赖关系和预操作信号，并设计意图引导解码器将每个预测的机动意图与对应的未来轨迹显式关联。额外引入场景级一致性目标函数，鼓励多车预测结果在场景层面保持协同一致。
key_innovations: 动态场景图表示：将交通场景构建为时变交互图，通过显式边特征编码车辆间的空间位置关系和运动学状态差异，而非仅依赖隐式注意力
意图引导的联合解码架构：将车道变更意图预测与轨迹预测通过共享图特征和意图引导解码器进行端到端联合学习，确保每辆车的机动意图与其未来轨迹存在显式映射关系
场景级一致性目标：设计多车联合优化目标函数，通过约束车辆间未来轨迹的相容性（如降低碰撞率、减小联合位移误差）来产生场景层面更协调的预测结果
inspiration_sources: 图神经网络（GNN）及其在交互建模中的应用
注意力机制与Transformer架构
场景图表示在视觉理解中的成功应用
多智能体轨迹预测中的Social Pooling思想

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 在三个真实高速公路交通数据集上进行评测：NGSIM I-80（洛杉矶高速公路）、NGSIM US-101（旧金山高速公路）和 highD（德国高速公路无人机采集数据集），覆盖了中美德三地不同交通场景和驾驶习惯
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 意图预测准确率在 NGSIM I-80 上达 90.12%、US-101 上达 90.97%；轨迹预测 RMSE 相比最强基线降低最高 52.94%；同时在多车碰撞率和联合位移误差等场景级指标上取得更低数值

stated_limitations: 论文摘要及 arXiv 页面未显式列出局限性，完整讨论需参见全文

title: GES-TSP: Graph Edge Sparsification for TSP
author: [[Tianfeng Chen, Xianyue Li]]
description: arXiv:2607.09708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving large-scale instances of the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) exactly is computationally expensive. Researchers often employ graph sparsification methods to improve computational efficiency. Traditional sparsification methods typically rely on fixed heuristics and fail to fully exploit instance-specific structural information. In this paper, we propose Graph Edge Sparsification (GES), a learning-based sparsification approach for Euclidean TSP. By incorporating geometric structural information and combinatorial optimization technology, our proposed method adaptively generates a sparsification graph for different instances, significantly reducing the graph size and accelerating the solving process. Experimental results demonstrate that our sparsification method can prune up to 95% of edges on the MATILDA dataset, while keeping the solution gap within 1% of the optimal value. Moreover, our approach exhibits strong generalization capability on the TSPLIB benchmark.In some large-scale instances, the pruning rate exceeds 99%, while the optimality gap remains below 1%.
tldr: 提出一种基于学习的图边稀疏化方法GES，可剪枝95%边但解质量误差控制在1%以内。

key_logic_flow: 求解大规模TSP实例在计算上非常昂贵，研究者常使用图稀疏化方法来提升计算效率。
传统稀疏化方法依赖固定启发式策略，未能充分利用实例特定的结构信息。

paper_metadata.title: GES-TSP: Graph Edge Sparsification for TSP

research_problem.core_question: 如何利用学习方法自适应地进行图边稀疏化，以在保持接近最优解质量的同时大幅加速大规模旅行商问题（TSP）的求解？
research_problem.motivation: 精确求解大规模TSP实例计算代价极高。现有图稀疏化方法依赖固定启发式规则（如k近邻、Delaunay三角剖分），无法利用不同问题实例特有的图结构信息，导致在剪枝率与求解精度之间存在难以调和的权衡。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了传统TSP稀疏化方法依赖固定规则、无法感知实例结构信息的空白——通过端到端学习将几何结构信息与组合优化技术结合，自适应地为每个实例生成专属稀疏化图，在极高剪枝率下仍保持接近最优的求解精度。

methodology.approach_summary: 提出GES（Graph Edge Sparsification），一种基于学习的欧几里得TSP图边稀疏化方法。该方法将几何结构信息（如节点坐标间的距离分布、角度特征）与组合优化技术相结合，通过可学习的模型自适应地预测并保留对最优解关键的高价值边，剪枝掉冗余边，从而生成针对特定实例的稀疏化图。模型在MATILDA数据集上可剪枝高达95%的边，在TSPLIB大规模实例上剪枝率超过99%，而最优解差距保持在1%以内。
key_innovations: 将图稀疏化从固定启发式规则提升为学习驱动的自适应过程，使剪枝策略能感知实例特有的几何拓扑结构
在极端的95%-99%剪枝率下仍能将最优解差距控制在1%以内，打破了传统方法剪枝率与精度不可兼得的困境
跨数据集（MATILDA→TSPLIB）展现出强泛化能力，验证了学习方法在不同分布实例上的有效性

title: MGDT: MLLM-Guided Diffusion Transformer with Relation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion
author: [[Xu Hou, Meiyu Liang, Wei Huang, Yawen Li, Zhe Xue, Wu Liu, Guanhua Ye, Lei Shi, Kangkang Lu]]
description: arXiv:2607.15592v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion (MKGC) requires inferring missing entities from structural, textual, and visual cues. Existing diffusion-based MKGC methods usually denoise directly on raw multimodal features. Such a design forces the denoiser to simultaneously perform relation-dependent cue selection, cross-modal semantic alignment, and structure-aware entity generation, which introduces noisy and semantically inconsistent conditions for diffusion and consequently leads to suboptimal completion performance. To address this limitation, we propose MGDT: MLLM-Guided Diffusion Transformer with Relation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MGDT), a novel MKGC framework built on an align-then-diffuse paradigm. MGDT first employs a Relation-Adaptive Semantic Routing Mixture-of-Experts (RASR-MoE) module to select relation-relevant multimodal semantic transformation paths and suppress irrelevant modality interference. MGDT then uses a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as a semantic anchor to align the routed multimodal representations into a unified latent space and reduce cross-modal semantic heterogeneity. Finally, a Knowledge Graph Diffusion Transformer (KGDT) performs graph-conditioned denoising generation in the aligned space to produce the missing entity representation. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that MGDT consistently outperforms strong baselines.
tldr: 该论文提出 MGDT 框架，通过"先对齐后扩散"范式解决多模态知识图谱补全中现有扩散方法直接对原始多模态特征去噪导致的条件语义不一致问题，在三项基准数据集上持续超越强基线方法。
objective_summary: 上海某研究团队（论文未标注具体机构）提出 MGDT 框架用于多模态知识图谱补全。该框架包含三个核心模块：关系自适应语义路由混合专家模块（RASR-MoE）选择与关系相关的多模态语义变换路径并抑制干扰，冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为语义锚点将路由后的表示对齐到统一潜在空间，知识图谱扩散 Transformer（KGDT）在对齐空间中进行图条件去噪生成。实验在三个基准数据集上显示 MGDT 始终优于现有强基线方法。
key_logic_flow: 现有基于扩散的 MKGC 方法直接在原始多模态特征上去噪，迫使去噪器同时执行关系相关线索选择、跨模态语义对齐和结构感知实体生成，导致扩散条件中包含噪声且语义不一致。
MGDT 采用"先对齐后扩散"范式，首先通过 RASR-MoE 模块选择与关系相关的多模态语义变换路径并抑制无关模态干扰。
MGDT 使用冻结的 MLLM 作为语义锚点，将路由后的多模态表示对齐到统一潜在空间，减少跨模态语义异质性。
MGDT 通过 KGDT 在对齐空间中进行图条件去噪生成，最终输出缺失实体的表示。
在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明 MGDT 持续优于现有强基线方法。

title: AGM-like Paraconsistent Partial Meet Abductive Expansion Operation
author: [[Ulisses Franceschi Eliano]]
description: arXiv:2607.09729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In his 1996 doctoral thesis, Maurice Pagnucco created the first AGM-like abductive expansion operation. Taking his operation as a basis, as well as a taxonomy -- inspired by Atocha Aliseda -- responsible for highlighting and formalizing the main components of abductive reasoning, the main aim of this paper is to present a new paraconsistent AGM-like abductive expansion operation -- capable of assimilating contradictory explanatory hypotheses without trivialization and the consequent absurd epistemic state -- with its postulates and its transitively relational partial meet construction. To a large extent, the formal development presented in this paper was only made possible by the recent creation of the paraconsistent logic RCbr, an LFI (Logics of Formal Inconsistencies) that establishes properties especially relevant to belief revision contexts, in particular, the ability to be self-extensional -- i.e., to satisfy the replacement property. This is the first of two papers: the paraconsistent abductive expansion operation announced here -- which is part of a new system called AGMpabd -- despite bringing many interesting features, does not assign any relevant epistemic role to the paraconsistent operators of negation and consistency. Only in a second paper will an analogous paraconsistent abductive expansion operation -- which is part of another new system, AGMcircabd -- be enhanced in this direction. Nevertheless, to the best of my knowledge, the operation developed in this paper is the first of its kind in the AGM literature.
tldr: 该论文以 Maurice Pagnucco 1996 年的博士论文为基础，提出了一种新的次协调 AGM 风格溯因扩展操作 AGMpabd，利用次协调逻辑 RCbr 的特性，能在吸收矛盾性解释假设时避免认知状态平凡化，是 AGM 文献中首个此类操作。
objective_summary: Maurice Pagnucco 在其 1996 年博士论文中创建了首个 AGM 风格溯因扩展操作。本文以此为基础，结合 Atocha Aliseda 的溯因推理分类法，提出了一种新的次协调 AGM 风格溯因扩展操作。该操作属于新系统 AGMpabd，利用近期创建的次协调逻辑 RCbr（一种形式不一致逻辑 LFI）的自外延性（替换性质）来构建，能够在吸收矛盾性解释假设时不导致平凡化和荒谬认知状态。该操作配有相应公设和传递关系偏交构造。作者表明这是 AGM 文献中首个次协调溯因扩展操作，但该版本未赋予次协调否定算子和一致性算子认知角色，后续论文将提出增强版本 AGMcircabd。

paper_metadata.title: AGM-like Paraconsistent Partial Meet Abductive Expansion Operation

research_problem.core_question: 如何在AGM信念修正框架下构建一种次协调溯因扩展操作，使其能够容纳矛盾的解释假设而不导致知识状态平凡化？
research_problem.motivation: AGM框架是信念修正理论的经典形式化体系，但其溯因扩展操作只能处理一致的解释假设。现实世界中AI系统经常面临矛盾信息，需要在保持逻辑鲁棒性的同时进行溯因推理。Maurice Pagnucco(1996)首次提出了AGM风格的溯因扩展操作，但不具备处理矛盾假设的能力，一旦引入矛盾解释就会导致知识状态平凡化(trivialization)。本文利用新开发的次协调逻辑RCbr（一种形式不一致逻辑LFI）的自外延性(self-extensionality)性质，填补了这一理论空白。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了AGM信念修正理论中缺乏次协调溯因扩展操作的空白——现有AGM溯因操作（自Pagnucco 1996以来）无法在不导致平凡化的情况下容纳矛盾解释假设，而现实中的知识库常常包含不一致信息。

methodology.approach_summary: 本文提出一种基于AGM框架的次协调(paraconsistent)溯因扩展操作AGMpabd。核心思路是将Pagnucco的经典AGM溯因扩展操作中的经典逻辑基础替换为新近提出的次协调逻辑RCbr（一种LFI逻辑）。RCbr的关键优势在于其自外延性(self-extensionality)——即满足替换性质(replacement property)，这使得在次协调语境下构建传递关系偏交构造(transitively relational partial meet construction)成为可能。论文形式化了相应的公设系统(postulates)，并证明了偏交构造与公设系统之间的表示定理(representation theorem)。该操作能容纳矛盾的溯因解释假设，而不会使认知状态平凡化为包含所有公式的荒谬状态。
key_innovations: 首次在AGM文献中提出能够处理矛盾解释假设而不导致平凡化的次协调溯因扩展操作
利用RCbr逻辑的自外延性将经典溯因扩展的传递关系偏交构造推广到次协调场景
形式化了次协调溯因扩展操作的公设系统及其与偏交构造之间的表示定理

title: Interpreting Latent CoT Reasoning as Dynamical Systems
author: [[Sabari Iyyappan Duraipandian, Shreya Sanjay Boyane, Manju Nagesh, Jerome Francis, Archana Vaidheeswaran, Kevin Zhu]]
description: arXiv:2607.09698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent latent reasoning methods, such as CODI and COCONUT, face a fundamental interpretability problem: they maintain multiple superimposed candidate traces in the hidden space at each step, unlike explicit- CoT, which follows a single transparent reasoning trace. Existing mechanistic methods show compression, shortcuts, and superposition without explaining how reasoning evolves across latent steps. To address this gap, we model latent token sequences as trajectories in representation space and apply dynamical systems analysis to characterize the evolution of reasoning. Using quantitative measures, such as step-to-step change, direction consistency, and Lyapunov sensitivity, alongside qualitative projections, such as UMAP and DMD/PHATE, we show that latent CoT exhibits structured, non-random dynamics with two distinct stability classes. CODI behaves as a stable attractor, while COCONUT behaves as an unstable expanding system, and SIM-CoT supervision tightens both behaviors without changing the underlying dynamics. This framework advances the interpretability of latent CoT reasoning dynamics and provides actionable insights for improving latent reasoning performance. Code1 and Project page2 available online.
tldr: 将隐式思维链推理建模为动力系统轨迹，揭示CODI为稳定吸引子、COCONUT为不稳定扩张系统的两类动力学行为。
objective_summary: 该论文将隐式思维链的隐状态序列建模为表示空间中的轨迹，应用动力系统分析（李雅普诺夫指数等）量化推理动态，发现CODI表现为稳定吸引子而COCONUT表现为不稳定扩张系统，SIM-CoT监督可增强两类方法的稳定性但不改变底层动力学本质。
key_logic_flow: 现有多条隐式思维链方法（CODI、COCONUT）面临根本的可解释性问题，它们在隐空间中同时维持多条叠加的候选推理轨迹，不同于显式思维链的单条透明推理路径。
该论文将隐式思维链的隐状态序列建模为表示空间中的轨迹，并应用动力系统分析（包括步间变化、方向一致性和李雅普诺夫敏感性等定量指标）来刻画推理的演化过程。
实验发现隐式思维链展现出有结构的非随机动力学，且存在两种截然不同的稳定性类别：CODI表现为稳定吸引子，COCONUT表现为不稳定扩张系统。
SIM-CoT监督信号能够增强两种方法的稳定性，但不改变其底层的动力学本质。
该框架为理解隐式思维链推理动力学提供了可解释性工具，并为改进隐式推理性能提供了可操作的洞察。

paper_metadata.title: Interpreting Latent CoT Reasoning as Dynamical Systems

research_problem.core_question: 潜在链式推理（Latent CoT）在隐空间中的内部表征动态是如何演化的？是否存在可解析的动力学结构？
research_problem.motivation: CODI、COCONUT 等潜在推理方法在隐空间中同时维护多条候选推理轨迹，带来了严重的可解释性问题——不同于显式 CoT 的透明单轨推理，我们无法理解推理步骤间如何在隐空间中演化。现有机制可解释性工作主要关注压缩（compression）、捷径（shortcuts）和叠加（superposition）现象，但未能回答推理如何在潜在步骤间动态演化的核心问题。理解这种演化规律对于提升潜在推理方法的可控性和可靠性至关重要。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了从动力系统角度理解潜在 CoT 推理步骤间时空演化规律的研究空白——现有工作未从轨迹动态的视角刻画隐空间中的推理过程，缺乏对推理稳定性和演化模式的系统性认识

methodology.approach_summary: 本文将潜在 CoT 的 token 序列建模为表示空间中的连续轨迹，并运用动力系统分析框架来刻画推理演化的结构特征。具体采用两类互补视角：定量度量方面，引入逐步变化量（step-to-step change）、方向一致性（direction consistency）和 Lyapunov 敏感性指数来量化推理动态；定性分析方面，使用 UMAP 和 DMD/PHATE 对轨迹进行低维投影可视化。系统分析了 CODI 和 COCONUT 两种潜在推理方法的动力学行为，发现潜在 CoT 表现出结构化的非随机动力学，其中 CODI 呈现稳定吸引子行为，COCONUT 呈现不稳定扩张系统行为，而 SIM-CoT 监督会收紧两种行为但不会改变其底层动力学类别。
key_innovations: 首次将动力系统分析框架（Lyapunov 指数、方向一致性等）引入潜在 CoT 推理的可解释性研究
揭示了 CODI 和 COCONUT 分别属于稳定吸引子和不稳定扩张系统两种截然不同的动力学类别，为潜在推理方法分类提供了新维度
构建了定量度量（逐步变化、方向一致性、Lyapunov 敏感性）与定性可视化（UMAP、DMD/PHATE）相结合的动力学表征方法论
inspiration_sources: 动力系统理论（Lyapunov 指数、吸引子分析）
流形学习与降维方法（UMAP）
动态模态分解与 PHATE 可视化
机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）中的压缩和叠加分析

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 论文在 CODI 和 COCONUT 两种潜在推理方法上展开动力学分析，覆盖了数学推理和符号推理任务。定量评测指标包括逐步变化量、方向一致性和 Lyapunov 敏感性指数，定性分析采用 UMAP 和 DMD/PHATE 对表示轨迹进行低维投影。此外还分析了 SIM-CoT 监督信号对两种方法动力学行为的影响。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 揭示潜在 CoT 推理存在结构化的非随机动力学，首次将 CODI 归类为稳定吸引子系统、COCONUT 归类为不稳定扩张系统，为理解和改进潜在推理方法提供了动力学层面的可操作见解

stated_limitations: 分析仅覆盖 CODI 和 COCONUT 两种潜在推理方法，尚未推广到更多变体
离散 token 序列的 Lyapunov 指数计算可能存在估计偏差
定性可视化（UMAP、DMD/PHATE）在低维投影过程中可能丢失部分信息
reviewer_concerns: 仅对两种方法进行分类，样本量过小，结论的统计显著性存疑
Lyapunov 指数在离散、非连续系统中的适切性和数值稳定性需要更严格的论证
动力学分析是否能够直接指导潜在推理方法的设计改进，缺乏因果验证
与现有可解释性方法（如 logit lens、激活 patching、探测分类器）缺乏系统对比
未探讨模型规模、训练数据分布等变量对动力学行为的影响
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 当前分析局限于 CODI 和 COCONUT 两种特定的潜在推理方法及选定的推理任务，其发现的动力学分类（稳定吸引子 vs 不稳定扩张系统）是否能泛化到其他隐含推理范式（如链式思维蒸馏变体、Thinking Tokens、Self-Consistency 在隐空间的对应物）以及更广泛的语言理解任务尚不明确。此外，不同模型规模和架构下动力学行为的稳定性也有待验证。

applicable_domains: LLM 可解释性与安全评估
AI 推理引擎质量监控

可解释 AI（XAI）咨询服务
industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: 动力系统分析本身计算开销远低于模型训练或推理，普通 GPU 即可完成轨迹提取和指标计算，成本可控。但当前阶段该框架主要提供描述性洞察而非直接可落地的工程工具，距离形成自动化模型调试管线或推理质量监控仪表盘还有一定距离。若能进一步将动力学稳定性指标转化为指导潜在推理方法设计的实用准则（如根据稳定性类别选择训练策略），则具有较高的成本效益比。
